Table highway.pavement_section {
  pavement_section_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique identifier for the pavement section within the highway system. Primary key for the pavement section master entity.']
  feature_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to gis.feature. Business justification: Pavement sections have defined geographic boundaries for maintenance planning and asset management. GIS feature provides spatial extent for work zone planning and material quantity calculations.']
  segment_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to highway.segment. Business justification: Pavement sections are linear subdivisions of highway segments for pavement management purposes. Each pavement section belongs to exactly one segment, defined by route and milepost range. Adding segmen']
  aadt varchar [note: 'Annual Average Daily Traffic volume representing the total volume of vehicle traffic on the pavement section for a year divided by 365 days. Key metric for pavement loading and deterioration.']
  aadt_year varchar [note: 'Year for which the AADT value was calculated or estimated.']
  alligator_cracking_percent decimal(5,2) [note: 'Percentage of pavement section area affected by alligator (fatigue) cracking. Interconnected cracks forming a pattern resembling alligator skin, indicating structural failure.']
  base_course_thickness_inches decimal(5,2) [note: 'Thickness of the base course layer measured in inches. Provides structural support and load distribution.']
  begin_milepost decimal(10,3) [note: 'Starting milepost location of the pavement section along the route. Measured in miles from route origin.']
  climate_zone varchar [note: 'North Carolina climate zone classification for the pavement section location. Affects pavement design parameters and deterioration rates. COASTAL=eastern coastal plain, PIEDMONT=central region, MOUNTAIN=western mountains.']
  construction_cost decimal(12,2) [note: 'Actual construction cost in US dollars for building or rehabilitating this pavement section. Includes materials, labor, and equipment.']
  construction_date date [note: 'Specific date when the pavement section construction was completed and opened to traffic.']
  construction_year varchar [note: 'Year when the pavement section was originally constructed. Used for age-based deterioration modeling and lifecycle analysis.']
  contractor_name varchar [note: 'Name of the contractor who constructed or performed major rehabilitation on this pavement section.']
  county_code varchar [note: 'North Carolina county code where the pavement section is located. Used for geographic and administrative reporting.']
  cracking_severity varchar [note: 'Overall severity rating of pavement cracking distresses including alligator cracking, longitudinal cracking, and transverse cracking. Ranges from NONE to SEVERE.']
  data_source varchar [note: 'Source system or database from which the pavement section data was obtained (e.g., Agile Assets, TIMS, HiCAMS).']
  deflection_basin_area decimal(8,2) [note: 'Area under the deflection basin curve measured during Falling Weight Deflectometer testing. Indicates overall pavement structural capacity and remaining life.']
  design_life_years varchar [note: 'Expected design life of the pavement structure in years. Typically 20 years for flexible pavements and 30-40 years for rigid pavements.']
  design_thickness_inches decimal(5,2) [note: 'Total design thickness of the pavement structure measured in inches, including all layers from surface to subgrade.']
  division_number varchar [note: 'NCDOT Division of Highways division number responsible for maintenance and operations of this pavement section. North Carolina has 14 highway divisions.']
  drainage_rating varchar [note: 'Rating of the pavement drainage system effectiveness. Good drainage is critical for pavement performance and longevity.']
  end_milepost decimal(10,3) [note: 'Ending milepost location of the pavement section along the route. Measured in miles from route origin.']
  environmental_clearance_type varchar [note: 'Type of NEPA environmental clearance obtained for the pavement project. CE=Categorical Exclusion, EA=Environmental Assessment, EIS=Environmental Impact Statement, FONSI=Finding of No Significant Impact.']
  esal_design_value varchar [note: 'Design traffic loading expressed as cumulative 18,000-pound equivalent single axle loads over the pavement design life. Used for structural pavement design.']
  estimated_treatment_cost decimal(12,2) [note: 'Estimated cost in US dollars to perform the recommended pavement treatment. Based on unit costs and section characteristics.']
  faulting_inches decimal(4,2) [note: 'Difference in elevation across concrete pavement joints measured in inches. Applicable to rigid pavements only. Caused by pumping and erosion of base materials.']
  federal_aid_program varchar [note: 'Specific federal aid program providing funding for this pavement section (e.g., NHPP, STP, HSIP, CMAQ). Applicable only for federally funded projects.']
  friction_number decimal(4,2) [note: 'Skid resistance measurement representing the friction between vehicle tires and pavement surface. Critical for safety. Measured using standardized friction testing equipment.']
  friction_test_date date [note: 'Date when the most recent pavement friction testing was performed.']
  frost_penetration_depth_inches decimal(4,1) [note: 'Expected depth of frost penetration into the pavement structure and subgrade measured in inches. Critical for pavement design in freeze-thaw climates.']
  functional_class_code varchar [note: 'FHWA functional classification code indicating the role of the roadway in serving mobility versus land access. Ranges from 1 (Interstate) to 9 (Local).']
  functional_class_description varchar [note: 'Descriptive name of the functional classification (e.g., Interstate, Principal Arterial, Minor Collector, Local).']
  funding_source varchar [note: 'Primary source of funding for the pavement construction or rehabilitation. STATE=state funds only, FEDERAL=federal funds, LOCAL=local funds, MIXED=combination of sources.']
  gis_latitude decimal(10,7) [note: 'Latitude coordinate of the pavement section midpoint in decimal degrees. Used for spatial analysis and mapping.']
  gis_longitude decimal(10,7) [note: 'Longitude coordinate of the pavement section midpoint in decimal degrees. Used for spatial analysis and mapping.']
  hpms_sample_indicator boolean [note: 'Flag indicating whether this pavement section is part of the HPMS sample for federal reporting. HPMS sample sections require more detailed data collection and reporting.']
  iri_collection_date date [note: 'Date when the IRI measurement was collected using automated pavement condition survey equipment.']
  iri_value decimal(6,2) [note: 'International Roughness Index measured in inches per mile. Quantifies pavement roughness and ride quality. Lower values indicate smoother pavement. Typical range 40-200 inches/mile.']
  lane_width_feet decimal(4,1) [note: 'Average width of a single traffic lane measured in feet. Standard lane widths range from 10 to 12 feet.']
  last_inspection_date date [note: 'Date of the most recent pavement condition inspection or survey.']
  last_updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when the pavement section record was last updated in the system.']
  letting_date date [note: 'Date when the construction contract for this pavement section was let (awarded) to a contractor. Key milestone in project delivery.']
  load_transfer_efficiency_percent decimal(5,2) [note: 'Percentage of load transferred across joints or cracks in rigid pavements. Measured using deflection testing. Higher values indicate better load transfer and structural performance.']
  longitudinal_cracking_feet decimal(8,2) [note: 'Total linear feet of longitudinal cracking parallel to the pavement centerline. Often occurs along construction joints or wheel paths.']
  maintenance_unit varchar [note: 'Maintenance unit or crew responsible for routine maintenance activities on this pavement section.']
  median_type varchar [note: 'Type of median separating opposing traffic directions. NONE=undivided, PAINTED=painted centerline only, RAISED=raised median, BARRIER=concrete barrier, DEPRESSED=depressed median.']
  median_width_feet decimal(5,1) [note: 'Width of the median measured in feet from edge of traveled way to edge of traveled way. Applicable only for divided highways.']
  next_inspection_date date [note: 'Scheduled date for the next pavement condition inspection or survey based on inspection frequency requirements.']
  nhs_indicator boolean [note: 'Flag indicating whether this pavement section is part of the National Highway System, which includes roadways important to the nation\'s economy, defense, and mobility.']
  noise_level_db decimal(5,2) [note: 'Tire-pavement noise level measured in decibels using on-board sound intensity method. Lower values indicate quieter pavement surfaces.']
  notes varchar [note: 'Free-text field for additional notes, comments, or special conditions related to the pavement section that do not fit in structured fields.']
  number_of_lanes varchar [note: 'Total number of through traffic lanes in both directions for this pavement section. Does not include auxiliary lanes, turn lanes, or shoulders.']
  overall_condition_rating varchar [note: 'Composite overall condition rating of the pavement section based on multiple distress indicators and performance measures. Used for prioritization and decision-making.']
  patching_percent decimal(5,2) [note: 'Percentage of pavement section area that has been patched or repaired. Indicates previous maintenance activity and potential for future deterioration.']
  pavement_age_years varchar [note: 'Age of the pavement section in years since original construction or last major rehabilitation. Used for deterioration modeling and lifecycle analysis.']
  pavement_structure_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the pavement structural design. FLEXIBLE=asphalt layers on aggregate base, RIGID=concrete slab, COMPOSITE=asphalt overlay on concrete base.']
  pci_collection_date date [note: 'Date when the PCI rating was determined through visual distress survey or automated assessment.']
  pci_value varchar [note: 'Pavement Condition Index rating on a scale of 0 to 100, where 100 represents excellent condition and 0 represents failed pavement. Composite measure based on distress type, severity, and extent.']
  permeability_rating varchar [note: 'Rating of pavement surface permeability to water infiltration. Affects durability and moisture-related distresses. Permeable pavements allow water to drain through the surface.']
  project_number varchar [note: 'NCDOT project number associated with the construction or major rehabilitation of this pavement section. Links to project management and financial systems.']
  psi_value decimal(3,1) [note: 'Present Serviceability Index rating on a scale of 0 to 5, where 5 represents excellent pavement condition and 0 represents failed pavement. Subjective measure of pavement ride quality.']
  recommended_treatment_type varchar [note: 'Type of pavement treatment recommended based on current condition and deterioration modeling. Categories align with NCDOT pavement preservation strategies.']
  recommended_treatment_year varchar [note: 'Fiscal year when the recommended pavement treatment should be performed based on condition forecasting and budget optimization.']
  remaining_service_life_years varchar [note: 'Estimated remaining service life in years before the pavement reaches terminal condition requiring major rehabilitation or reconstruction.']
  rutting_depth_inches decimal(4,2) [note: 'Maximum rut depth measured in inches in the wheel path. Rutting is a longitudinal depression in the pavement surface caused by consolidation or lateral movement of materials.']
  section_length_miles decimal(10,3) [note: 'Total length of the pavement section measured in miles. Calculated as end_milepost minus begin_milepost.']
  shoulder_width_feet decimal(4,1) [note: 'Average width of the paved or unpaved shoulder measured in feet. Provides emergency stopping area and lateral support for pavement structure.']
  status varchar [note: 'Current operational status of the pavement section. ACTIVE=in service, INACTIVE=temporarily closed, PLANNED=future construction, UNDER_CONSTRUCTION=currently being built, DECOMMISSIONED=removed from service.']
  stip_project_indicator boolean [note: 'Flag indicating whether this pavement section is part of a project included in the North Carolina State Transportation Improvement Program.']
  structural_number decimal(4,2) [note: 'AASHTO Structural Number representing the overall structural capacity of the pavement. Calculated from layer thicknesses and material coefficients. Higher values indicate stronger pavement structure.']
  subgrade_resilient_modulus_psi varchar [note: 'Resilient modulus of the subgrade soil measured in pounds per square inch. Represents the elastic stiffness of the subgrade under repeated loading. Key input for mechanistic pavement design.']
  subgrade_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the subgrade soil type underlying the pavement structure. Affects bearing capacity and pavement design requirements.']
  surface_course_thickness_inches decimal(5,2) [note: 'Thickness of the surface course layer measured in inches. The wearing surface that provides skid resistance and smoothness.']
  surface_type_code varchar [note: 'Code representing the pavement surface type. AC=Asphalt Concrete, PCC=Portland Cement Concrete, COMP=Composite, UNPAVED=Gravel or Dirt, BRICK=Brick or Block, OTHER=Other surface types.']
  surface_type_description varchar [note: 'Detailed description of the pavement surface type and composition, including specific materials and construction methods used.']
  texture_depth_mm decimal(4,2) [note: 'Mean texture depth of the pavement surface measured in millimeters. Affects skid resistance, noise, and splash/spray. Measured using sand patch or laser methods.']
  transverse_cracking_count varchar [note: 'Number of transverse cracks perpendicular to the pavement centerline. Often caused by thermal contraction or reflection from underlying layers.']
  treatment_priority_rank varchar [note: 'Numerical ranking of this pavement section for treatment priority within the network. Lower numbers indicate higher priority for maintenance or rehabilitation.']
  truck_percentage decimal(5,2) [note: 'Percentage of total traffic volume consisting of trucks and heavy vehicles. Critical for pavement design and deterioration modeling as trucks cause significantly more pavement damage than passenger vehicles.']
  urban_rural_designation varchar [note: 'Classification of the pavement section location as urban, rural, or small urban area based on Census Bureau definitions and population density.']
  warranty_expiration_date date [note: 'Date when the construction warranty period expires. Applicable only for warranty projects.']
  warranty_indicator boolean [note: 'Flag indicating whether this pavement section was constructed under a warranty contract requiring the contractor to maintain performance standards for a specified period.']

  Note: 'Master entity for pavement sections, linking to segment and storing surface type, design thickness, and construction year.'
}

Table highway.sensor_reading {
  sensor_reading_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique identifier for each sensor reading record captured from roadway monitoring equipment.']

  lane_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to highway.lane. Business justification: Many roadway sensors are installed in specific lanes for lane-level monitoring (e.g., weigh-in-motion sensors, lane-specific traffic counters, pavement strain gauges). Sensor_reading has lane_number a']

  aggregation_period_minutes varchar [note: 'Time period in minutes over which sensor readings are aggregated for reporting (e.g., 5-minute, 15-minute intervals).']
  air_quality_index varchar [note: 'Air Quality Index value (0-500) measured by air quality monitoring sensors near roadways.']
  air_temperature_celsius decimal(7,2) [note: 'Ambient air temperature measurement in degrees Celsius from weather station sensors.']

  calibration_due_date date [note: 'Scheduled date for the next required sensor calibration based on maintenance intervals.']

  installation_date date [note: 'Date when the sensor was installed at the current location.']
  installation_depth_mm decimal(8,2) [note: 'Depth in millimeters at which the sensor is installed below the pavement surface or reference point.']
  international_roughness_index decimal(8,3) [note: 'International Roughness Index measurement in meters per kilometer or inches per mile indicating pavement smoothness.']
  latitude decimal(10,7) [note: 'Geographic latitude coordinate of the sensor location in decimal degrees.']
  longitude decimal(11,7) [note: 'Geographic longitude coordinate of the sensor location in decimal degrees.']
  maintenance_status varchar [note: 'Current maintenance status of the sensor device.']
  milepost decimal(10,3) [note: 'Milepost location along the route where the sensor is positioned, measured from the route origin.']
  moisture_percent decimal(6,3) [note: 'Moisture content percentage measured in pavement layers or subgrade materials.']
  nhs_indicator boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the roadway segment is part of the National Highway System.']
  noise_level_decibels decimal(6,2) [note: 'Ambient noise level measurement in decibels from roadway noise monitoring sensors.']
  particulate_matter_pm10 decimal(8,3) [note: 'Concentration of particulate matter 10 micrometers or smaller in micrograms per cubic meter.']
  particulate_matter_pm25 decimal(8,3) [note: 'Concentration of particulate matter 2.5 micrometers or smaller in micrograms per cubic meter.']
  pavement_condition_index decimal(5,2) [note: 'Pavement Condition Index score (0-100) indicating overall pavement condition based on sensor-derived distress measurements.']
  pavement_layer varchar [note: 'Pavement structural layer where the sensor is embedded or monitoring (applicable for pavement sensors).']
  precipitation_mm decimal(8,2) [note: 'Precipitation amount in millimeters measured during the reading interval by weather sensors.']
  pressure_psi decimal(10,3) [note: 'Pressure measurement in pounds per square inch for stress or load monitoring.']
  reading_quality_code varchar [note: 'Quality assessment code indicating the reliability and validity of the sensor reading.']
  reading_status varchar [note: 'Current processing status of the sensor reading within the data management lifecycle.']
  reading_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Precise date and time when the sensor reading was captured, formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.']
  reading_value decimal(18,6) [note: 'Numeric value of the measurement captured by the sensor at the reading timestamp.']
  relative_humidity_percent decimal(5,2) [note: 'Relative humidity percentage measured by weather station sensors.']
  road_surface_condition varchar [note: 'Current road surface condition detected by environmental sensors for winter maintenance operations.']
  rut_depth_mm decimal(7,2) [note: 'Pavement rutting depth measurement in millimeters captured by automated profiling sensors.']
  salt_concentration_percent decimal(6,3) [note: 'Salt or chemical treatment concentration percentage on the pavement surface measured by environmental sensors.']
  sensor_manufacturer varchar [note: 'Name of the manufacturer or vendor that produced the sensor device.']
  sensor_model varchar [note: 'Model number or designation of the sensor device as specified by the manufacturer.']
  sensor_serial_number varchar [note: 'Unique serial number assigned by the manufacturer to the individual sensor unit.']
  sensor_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the sensor type indicating what physical property or condition is being measured.']
  signal_strength_dbm decimal(7,2) [note: 'Communication signal strength in dBm for wireless sensor connectivity monitoring.']
  strain_microstrain decimal(12,3) [note: 'Strain measurement in microstrain units indicating deformation or stress in pavement structure.']
  temperature_celsius decimal(8,3) [note: 'Temperature measurement in degrees Celsius captured by temperature sensors for pavement or ambient conditions.']
  traffic_volume_count varchar [note: 'Number of vehicles counted by traffic counter sensors during the measurement interval.']
  unit_of_measure varchar [note: 'Standard unit of measurement for the reading value (e.g., Celsius for temperature, percent for moisture, microstrain for strain).']
  validated_by varchar [note: 'Username or identifier of the person or system that validated the sensor reading.']
  validation_method varchar [note: 'Method used to validate the accuracy and quality of the sensor reading.']
  validation_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time when the sensor reading was validated.']
  vehicle_class varchar [note: 'FHWA vehicle classification code (1-13) identifying the vehicle type based on axle configuration.']
  vehicle_speed_mph decimal(6,2) [note: 'Vehicle speed measurement in miles per hour captured by traffic monitoring sensors.']
  vehicle_weight_tons decimal(8,2) [note: 'Vehicle weight measurement in tons captured by weigh-in-motion sensors.']
  vibration_frequency_hz decimal(10,3) [note: 'Vibration frequency measurement in Hertz for structural health monitoring.']
  visibility_meters decimal(8,2) [note: 'Visibility distance in meters measured by weather station sensors for roadway safety monitoring.']
  warranty_expiration_date date [note: 'Date when the manufacturer warranty for the sensor device expires.']
  wind_direction_degrees decimal(5,2) [note: 'Wind direction in degrees (0-360) from true north measured by weather station sensors.']
  wind_speed_mph decimal(6,2) [note: 'Wind speed measurement in miles per hour from weather station sensors.']

  Note: 'Telemetry from roadway sensors (e.g., temperature, moisture, strain), timestamped for condition monitoring and predictive maintenance.'
}

  truck_route_designation_eligible boolean [note: 'Indicates whether roadways in this functional classification are typically eligible for designation as truck routes.']

  typical_aadt_range_min varchar [note: 'Minimum typical Annual Average Daily Traffic volume expected for roadways in this functional classification. Used for planning and classification validation.']
  typical_lane_count varchar [note: 'Typical number of through lanes (both directions combined) for roadways in this functional classification.']
  typical_lane_width_feet varchar [note: 'Typical width of travel lanes in feet for roadways in this functional classification, per AASHTO design standards.']
  typical_shoulder_width_feet varchar [note: 'Typical shoulder width in feet for roadways in this functional classification, per AASHTO design standards.']
  typical_trip_length_miles decimal(10,2) [note: 'Average trip length in miles for trips using roadways in this functional classification. Used for travel demand modeling and planning.']
  urban_rural_designation varchar [note: 'Indicates whether this functional classification applies to urban areas, rural areas, or both. Critical for HPMS reporting and federal funding eligibility.']
  vmt_contribution_percentage decimal(5,2) [note: 'Approximate percentage of statewide Vehicle Miles Traveled contributed by roadways in this functional classification. Used for system performance analysis.']

  Note: 'Reference table defining roadway functional classes (e.g., Interstate, Principal Arterial, Collector) used for reporting and analysis.'
}

Table highway.pavement_treatment {
  pavement_treatment_id varchar [pk, note: 'Primary key for the pavement_treatment association']
  pavement_section_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the pavement section receiving treatment']
  project_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the transportation project that delivered the treatment']
  completion_date date [note: 'Actual date when the treatment work was completed and the pavement section was reopened to traffic.']
  last_overlay_date date [note: 'Specific date when the most recent overlay or resurfacing treatment was completed. [Moved from pavement_section: This attribute represents the most recent overlay treatment date, which should be derived from the pavement_treatment association rather than stored redundantly on pavement_section.]']
  last_overlay_year varchar [note: 'Year when the most recent overlay or resurfacing treatment was applied to the pavement section. [Moved from pavement_section: This attribute represents the most recent overlay treatment, which should be derived from the pavement_treatment association rather than stored redundantly on pavement_section. The association provides the complete treatment history.]']
  last_rehabilitation_date date [note: 'Specific date when the most recent major rehabilitation work was completed. [Moved from pavement_section: This attribute represents the most recent rehabilitation treatment date, which should be derived from the pavement_treatment association rather than stored redundantly on pavement_section.]']
  last_rehabilitation_year varchar [note: 'Year when the most recent major rehabilitation work was performed on the pavement section, including reconstruction or major structural improvements. [Moved from pavement_section: This attribute represents the most recent rehabilitation treatment, which should be derived from the pavement_treatment association rather than stored redundantly on pavement_section.]']
  post_condition_rating decimal(5,2) [note: 'Pavement condition index or rating assessed after the treatment was completed. Used to measure treatment effectiveness and expected service life extension.']
  pre_condition_rating decimal(5,2) [note: 'Pavement condition index or rating assessed before the treatment was applied. Used to establish baseline condition and justify treatment selection.']
  scheduled_work_date date [note: 'Planned date for the treatment work to be performed on this pavement section as part of the project schedule.']
  treatment_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the pavement treatment work performed. Identifies the specific maintenance or rehabilitation strategy applied to the section.']
  work_scope varchar [note: 'Detailed description of the specific work performed on this pavement section, including materials used, layer thicknesses, and any special treatments or conditions.']

  Note: 'This association product represents the treatment event between pavement_section and project. It captures the specific work performed on a pavement section as part of a transportation project. Each record links one pavement_section to one project with attributes that describe the treatment type, timing, scope, and condition assessment before and after the work.. Existence Justification: In NCDOT pavement management operations, a single pavement section receives multiple treatments over its lifecycle (crack seal in 2020, overlay in 2023, rehabilitation in 2028), and a single transportation project typically treats multiple pavement sections (a district-wide resurfacing contract may treat 50+ sections). The relationship between pavement sections and projects is operationally managed as treatment events with specific attributes: treatment type, scheduled and actual dates, before/after condition ratings, and work scope details.'
}

Table highway.construction_impact {
  construction_impact_id varchar [pk, note: 'Primary key for the construction_impact association']
  construction_activity_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the highway construction activity causing the transit impact']
  route_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the transit route affected by the construction activity']
  detour_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the transit route must be detoured due to this construction activity. Triggers detour planning and signage updates.']
  impact_end_date date [note: 'Date when the construction activity impact on the transit route is expected to end and normal service resumes. Used for planning restoration of regular service.']
  impact_start_date date [note: 'Date when the construction activity begins to affect the transit route operations. Used for scheduling service modifications and public notifications.']
  notification_status varchar [note: 'Current status of public notification regarding this construction impact. Tracks whether affected riders have been informed of service changes.']
  service_modification_type varchar [note: 'Classification of how the transit service must be modified due to the construction activity. Determines operational response and public communication strategy.']

  Note: 'This association product represents the impact event between construction_activity and route. It captures the specific effects of highway construction on transit route operations, including detours, service modifications, and public notification requirements. Each record links one construction_activity to one route with attributes that exist only in the context of this relationship.. Existence Justification: Highway construction activities frequently impact multiple transit routes simultaneously when work occurs in areas served by multiple bus, rail, or ferry routes. Conversely, each transit route is affected by multiple construction activities over time as different highway segments along or near the route undergo maintenance and improvement. NCDOT actively manages these impacts as operational events, tracking specific detour requirements, service modifications, and public notification status for each construction-route combination to coordinate multimodal transportation operations.'
}

Table highway.segment_scenario_treatment {
  segment_scenario_treatment_id varchar [pk, note: 'Primary key for the segment_scenario_treatment association']
  scenario_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the planning scenario under which this treatment is proposed']
  segment_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the highway segment being evaluated in this scenario']
  condition_improvement decimal(5,2) [note: 'The expected improvement in pavement condition rating resulting from this treatment in this scenario']
  created_date timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this segment-scenario treatment record was created in the planning system']
  estimated_cost decimal(15,2) [note: 'The estimated cost in dollars for implementing the proposed treatment on this segment under this scenario']
  implementation_year varchar [note: 'The target year for implementing this treatment on this segment within the scenario timeline']
  modified_date timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this segment-scenario treatment record was last modified']
  priority_rank varchar [note: 'The priority ranking of this segment treatment within the scenario, used for funding allocation decisions']
  treatment_type varchar [note: 'The type of treatment or improvement strategy proposed for this segment in this scenario (e.g., Overlay, Rehabilitation, Reconstruction, Widening)']

  Note: 'This association product represents the treatment or improvement strategy applied to a specific highway segment within a specific planning scenario. It captures the investment decisions, cost estimates, and implementation priorities that exist only in the context of evaluating a segment under a particular planning scenario. Each record links one segment to one scenario with attributes describing the proposed treatment approach.. Existence Justification: In transportation planning operations, NCDOT creates multiple planning scenarios (baseline, growth, climate-impact) to evaluate different investment strategies. Each scenario evaluates hundreds or thousands of highway segments with different proposed treatments, costs, and priorities. A single segment appears in multiple scenarios with different treatment approaches (e.g., overlay in baseline, reconstruction in growth scenario), and each scenario includes many segments. Planning analysts actively manage these segment-scenario-treatment combinations to compare funding allocation strategies.'
}

Table highway.route {

  route_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the route based on functional hierarchy and jurisdiction within the transportation network. Determines maintenance responsibility and funding eligibility.']
  scenic_byway_indicator boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the route is designated as a state or national scenic byway based on scenic, historic, cultural, natural, recreational, or archaeological qualities.']
  speed_limit_mph varchar [note: 'Primary posted speed limit for the route in miles per hour. May vary by segment; this represents the predominant or maximum speed limit for the route.']
  status varchar [note: 'Current operational status of the route within the state highway system. Active routes are open to traffic; inactive routes are closed or removed from the system; under construction routes are being built or reconstructed.']
  strahnet_indicator boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the route is part of the Strategic Highway Network, a system of public highways designated for defense purposes and military mobilization. STRAHNET routes must meet specific geometric and weight standards.']
  surface_type varchar [note: 'Predominant pavement surface type for the route. Critical for maintenance planning, performance monitoring, and lifecycle cost analysis.']
  termination_date date [note: 'Date when the route designation was terminated, decommissioned, or reclassified. Null for active routes. Used for historical tracking and system changes.']
  toll_indicator boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the route includes toll collection facilities requiring payment for use.']
  total_length_miles decimal(10,3) [note: 'Total centerline length of the route in miles within North Carolina state boundaries. Used for asset inventory, funding allocation, and performance reporting.']
  truck_percentage decimal(5,2) [note: 'Percentage of total traffic volume consisting of commercial trucks and heavy vehicles. Used for pavement design, maintenance planning, and freight mobility analysis.']
  truck_route_indicator boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the route is designated for commercial truck traffic with appropriate weight limits, clearances, and geometric standards.']
  urban_rural_designation varchar [note: 'Classification of the route location as urban or rural based on population density and Census Bureau urbanized area boundaries. Affects functional classification, design standards, and federal funding formulas.']

  Note: 'Master reference table for route. Referenced by route_id.'
}

Table dmv.vehicle {
  vehicle_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique system identifier for each vehicle registered in North Carolina. Primary key for the vehicle master record.']
  abs_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the vehicle is equipped with anti-lock braking system.']

  mandatory_court_appearance_indicator boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the violation requires a mandatory court appearance by the driver.']
  mile_marker decimal(6,2) [note: 'Mile marker or milepost location on the highway where the violation occurred.']
  officer_badge_number varchar [note: 'Badge or identification number of the law enforcement officer who issued the citation.']
  officer_name varchar [note: 'Name of the law enforcement officer who issued the citation.']
  original_violation_code varchar [note: 'Original violation code if the charge was subsequently reduced or amended.']
  out_of_state_violation_indicator boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the violation occurred outside of North Carolina and was reported to NC DMV through interstate compact.']
  payment_date date [note: 'Date on which payment was received for the violation.']
  payment_due_date date [note: 'Date by which payment for the violation must be received to avoid additional penalties.']
  payment_method varchar [note: 'Method used to pay the violation fine (e.g., cash, check, credit card, online payment).']
  points_assessed varchar [note: 'Number of points assessed against the driver\'s license for the violation under the NC point system.']
  prayer_for_judgment_indicator boolean [note: 'Indicates whether a Prayer for Judgment Continued was granted for the violation, which defers judgment and may prevent insurance and license points.']
  reported_to_dmv_indicator boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the violation has been reported to the NC DMV for inclusion in the driver\'s Motor Vehicle Record (MVR).']
  revocation_indicator boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the violation resulted in driver license revocation.']
  route_number varchar [note: 'Highway or route number where the violation occurred (e.g., I-40, US-1, NC-55).']
  school_zone_indicator boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the violation occurred in a designated school zone.']
  severity varchar [note: 'Legal severity classification of the violation (infraction, misdemeanor, or felony).']
  source_state varchar [note: 'State that reported the out-of-state violation to NC DMV, using two-letter state abbreviation.']
  speed_limit varchar [note: 'Posted speed limit in miles per hour at the location where the violation occurred.']
  speed_over_limit varchar [note: 'Number of miles per hour over the posted speed limit for speeding violations.']
  state varchar [note: 'State where the violation occurred, typically NC for North Carolina violations.']
  street_address varchar [note: 'Street address or nearest address to where the violation occurred.']
  suspension_duration_days varchar [note: 'Total number of days for which the driver license is suspended due to the violation.']
  suspension_end_date date [note: 'Date on which driver license suspension ends and driving privileges may be restored.']
  suspension_start_date date [note: 'Date on which driver license suspension begins as a result of the violation.']
  time timestamp [note: 'Precise date and time when the traffic violation occurred.']
  total_amount_due decimal(10,2) [note: 'Total amount due including fine, court costs, and any additional fees in US dollars.']
  warrant_issue_date date [note: 'Date on which a warrant was issued related to the violation.']
  warrant_issued_indicator boolean [note: 'Indicates whether a warrant has been issued for failure to appear or failure to pay the violation.']
  work_zone_indicator boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the violation occurred in an active highway work zone.']
  zip_code varchar [note: 'ZIP code of the location where the violation occurred.']

  Note: 'Transactional record of traffic citations issued to drivers, including violation code, date, location, fine amount, and adjudication status.'
}

  service_channel varchar [note: 'Comma-separated list of channels through which this fee can be collected (e.g., DMV office, online portal, mail, contracted agent, kiosk).']
  state_portion_amount decimal(10,2) [note: 'Portion of the fee amount retained by the state after vendor fees and distribution. Null if entire amount goes to state.']
  status varchar [note: 'Current operational status of the fee (active, inactive, suspended, pending legislative approval, superseded by newer fee).']
  statutory_reference varchar [note: 'North Carolina General Statute (NCGS) citation that establishes the legal authority and amount for this fee.']
  subcategory varchar [note: 'More granular classification within the fee category (e.g., original issuance, renewal, replacement, transfer).']

  transaction_type varchar [note: 'Type of DMV transaction to which this fee applies (e.g., original issuance, renewal, duplicate, replacement, transfer, reinstatement).']
  vehicle_class varchar [note: 'Vehicle classification to which this fee applies (e.g., passenger, motorcycle, commercial, trailer). Null if not vehicle-specific.']
  vendor_portion_amount decimal(10,2) [note: 'Portion of the fee amount retained by third-party vendor or contractor. Null if no third-party involvement.']
  waiver_conditions varchar [note: 'Description of conditions under which the fee may be waived (e.g., active military duty, Purple Heart recipient, disabled veteran).']
  waiver_eligible boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this fee is eligible for waiver under specific circumstances (e.g., military service, disability, hardship).']

  Note: 'Reference table of all fee types charged by the DMV (e.g., license issuance, renewal, title transfer), with amount, applicable vehicle class, and regulatory code.'

Table dmv.crash_involvement {
  crash_involvement_id varchar [pk, note: 'Primary key for the crash_involvement association']
  crash_report_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the crash report']
  driver_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the driver master record']
  airbag_deployed boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the airbag deployed for this driver in this crash']
  alcohol_test_result decimal(4,3) [note: 'Blood alcohol content (BAC) test result for this driver in this crash, if tested']
  citation_issued boolean [note: 'Boolean flag indicating whether a citation was issued to this driver at the scene of this crash. This attribute was explicitly identified in the detection phase relationship data.']
  citation_number varchar [note: 'Official citation number if a citation was issued to this driver for this crash']
  contributing_factors varchar [note: 'Comma-separated list of contributing factors attributed to this driver for this crash (e.g., speeding, distraction, impairment)']
  driver_role varchar [note: 'The role of the driver in the crash event (e.g., Driver, Passenger, Witness). This attribute was explicitly identified in the detection phase relationship data.']
  drug_test_result varchar [note: 'Drug test result for this driver in this crash, if tested']
  ejected_from_vehicle boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this driver was ejected from the vehicle during this crash']
  fault_percentage decimal(5,2) [note: 'Percentage of fault assigned to this driver for this crash, determined during crash investigation. This attribute was explicitly identified in the detection phase relationship data.']
  hospital_name varchar [note: 'Name of the hospital to which this driver was transported, if applicable']
  injury_severity varchar [note: 'Severity of injury sustained by this driver in this crash. This attribute was explicitly identified in the detection phase relationship data.']
  transported_to_hospital boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this driver was transported to a hospital from the crash scene']
  vehicle_unit_number varchar [note: 'Unit number assigned to the vehicle this driver was associated with in the crash report (for multi-vehicle crashes)']

  Note: 'This association product represents the involvement of a driver in a crash event. It captures the specific role, fault determination, injury status, and citations for each driver involved in each crash. Each record links one driver to one crash_report with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific involvement.. Existence Justification: In NCDOT operations, a single crash event routinely involves multiple drivers (multi-vehicle collisions, witnesses, pedestrians), and individual drivers accumulate involvement in multiple crashes over their driving history. Law enforcement and safety investigators actively manage crash involvement records as operational entities, documenting each driver\'s specific role, fault determination, injury status, and citations issued at the scene. This is not an analytical correlation but an operational business process where crash investigators create, update, and query involvement records.'
}

Table dmv.vehicle_crash_involvement {
  vehicle_crash_involvement_id varchar [pk, note: 'Primary key for the vehicle_crash_involvement association']
  crash_report_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the crash report documenting this incident']
  vehicle_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the vehicle master record involved in this crash']
  contributing_factor varchar [note: 'Primary contributing factor attributed to this vehicle or its driver (e.g., speed, failure to yield, distraction, impairment). Used for crash causation and prevention programs.']
  damage_severity varchar [note: 'Assessment of damage sustained by this vehicle in this specific crash. Used for total loss determination, insurance claims, and crash severity analysis.']
  occupant_count varchar [note: 'Number of occupants in this specific vehicle at the time of the crash. Used for injury analysis and safety research.']
  point_of_impact varchar [note: 'Location on this vehicle where initial impact occurred. Used for crash reconstruction and injury pattern analysis.']
  pre_crash_action varchar [note: 'Action the vehicle was taking immediately prior to the crash (e.g., going straight, turning left, changing lanes, stopped). Critical for crash causation analysis.']
  recorded_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this vehicle involvement record was created in the system during crash investigation.']
  towed_indicator boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this vehicle was towed from the crash scene due to damage or other factors. Important for crash severity metrics and operational response tracking.']
  vehicle_role varchar [note: 'The role this specific vehicle played in the crash event (e.g., striking vehicle, struck vehicle, parked vehicle). Critical for liability determination and crash reconstruction.']
  vehicle_sequence varchar [note: 'Sequential number assigned to this vehicle within the crash report (Vehicle 1, Vehicle 2, etc.) for reference in narrative and diagrams.']

  Note: 'This association product represents the involvement of a specific vehicle in a specific crash event. It captures the operational details of each vehicle\'s participation in a crash, including the vehicle\'s role in the collision, damage assessment, towing status, and occupant count. Each record links one vehicle to one crash report with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific involvement.. Existence Justification: In North Carolina crash reporting operations, a single crash event routinely involves multiple vehicles (pile-ups, intersection collisions, multi-vehicle chain reactions), and any given vehicle can be involved in multiple separate crash events over its registration lifetime. NCDOT crash investigators actively create and manage vehicle involvement records as part of the crash investigation process, documenting each vehicle\'s specific role, damage level, and contributing factors for every crash.'
}

  truck_traffic_percent decimal(5,2) [note: 'Percentage of AADT that consists of truck traffic (vehicles with more than four tires touching the pavement).']
  underclearance_evaluation varchar [note: 'Single-digit rating (0-9 or N) evaluating the adequacy of vertical and horizontal clearances under the bridge.']
  vertical_clearance_ft decimal(6,2) [note: 'Minimum vertical clearance under the bridge measured in feet from the roadway surface to the lowest structural member.']
  vertical_clearance_over_ft decimal(6,2) [note: 'Minimum vertical clearance over the bridge measured in feet from the bridge deck to overhead structures.']
  waterway_adequacy_evaluation varchar [note: 'Single-digit rating (0-9 or N) evaluating the adequacy of the waterway opening for bridges over waterways.']
  wearing_surface_type_code varchar [note: 'Single-digit code identifying the type of wearing surface on the bridge deck.']
  work_done_by_code varchar [note: 'Single-digit code identifying the entity responsible for performing proposed work (e.g., state forces, contract).']
  work_proposed_code varchar [note: 'Two-digit code identifying the type of work proposed for the bridge (e.g., replacement, rehabilitation, widening).']
  year_built varchar [note: 'Four-digit year when the original bridge structure was constructed and opened to traffic.']
  year_of_improvement_cost_estimate varchar [note: 'Four-digit year when the improvement cost estimate was prepared.']
  year_reconstructed varchar [note: 'Four-digit year when the bridge was reconstructed or underwent major rehabilitation that significantly changed its structural characteristics.']

  Note: 'Authoritative master record for each state-owned bridge, capturing unique bridge identifier, location (latitude/longitude), structure type, span length, year built, ownership, and key attributes for asset management and regulatory reporting.'
}

Table bridge.inspection_type {

  frequency_months varchar [note: 'Standard inspection frequency interval in months as defined by NBIS or NCDOT policy. For example, routine inspections are typically 24 months, fracture critical inspections may be 24 months, and underwater inspections may be 60 months.']
  inspection_level varchar [note: 'Inspection depth level as defined by AASHTO Manual for Bridge Evaluation: Level 1 (visual), Level 2 (detailed visual with access), Level 3 (highly detailed with NDE), Level 4 (laboratory testing).']
  last_updated_date date [note: 'Date when this inspection type definition was last reviewed or updated in the system.']

  minimum_frequency_months varchar [note: 'Minimum allowable frequency interval in months for this inspection type, representing the most frequent inspection cycle permitted under NBIS or NCDOT standards.']
  name varchar [note: 'Full descriptive name of the inspection type (e.g., Routine Inspection, Special Inspection, Fracture Critical Member Inspection, Underwater Inspection, Damage Inspection, In-Depth Inspection).']
  nbi_submission_required_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether results from this inspection type must be submitted to the National Bridge Inventory database maintained by FHWA.']

  qualified_inspector_level varchar [note: 'Minimum qualification level required for inspectors performing this inspection type, as defined by NBIS and NCDOT certification standards (e.g., team leader, bridge inspector, fracture critical inspector, underwater inspector, NDE technician).']
  quality_assurance_level varchar [note: 'Level of quality assurance review required for inspection reports of this type: Level 1 (peer review), Level 2 (supervisory review), Level 3 (independent QA team review). Higher risk inspection types require higher QA levels.']

  reporting_format varchar [note: 'Standard reporting format or template required for documenting results of this inspection type (e.g., NBI format for routine inspections, detailed narrative report for special inspections, NDE report for non-destructive evaluation).']
  review_approval_required_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether inspection reports of this type require formal review and approval by a qualified team leader or program manager before finalization.']
  safety_risk_level varchar [note: 'Assessment of inherent safety risk to inspection personnel performing this inspection type: extreme (underwater, high elevation rope access), high (under-bridge access, confined spaces), moderate (traffic exposure), low (visual from ground).']
  scope varchar [note: 'Defines the extent of the bridge structure covered by this inspection type: full structure (entire bridge), partial structure (selected spans or sections), specific component (deck, superstructure, substructure), underwater only (submerged elements), or fracture critical only (FCM members).']
  seasonal_restrictions varchar [note: 'Description of any seasonal restrictions or preferred timing for this inspection type (e.g., underwater inspections best performed in summer, avoid winter for detailed inspections due to ice, environmental restrictions during nesting season).']
  special_equipment_required_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether specialized equipment beyond standard inspection tools is required for this inspection type (e.g., underwater diving gear, ultrasonic testing equipment, snooper trucks, drones).']
  superseded_by_inspection_type varchar [note: 'Code or name of the inspection type that replaced this inspection type, if applicable. Used to track evolution of inspection standards and practices.']
  team_size_minimum varchar [note: 'Minimum number of qualified personnel required to safely and effectively perform this inspection type, as defined by NBIS safety standards and NCDOT policy.']
  traffic_control_required_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether traffic control measures (lane closures, flaggers, work zone setup) are typically required to perform this inspection type safely.']
  trigger_event varchar [note: 'Specific event or condition that triggers this inspection type (e.g., hurricane, flood, earthquake, vehicle impact, fire, structural damage report, routine schedule). Applicable primarily to unscheduled and emergency inspection types.']
  video_documentation_required_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether video documentation is required for this inspection type (typically true for underwater inspections and some special inspections).']
  weather_dependent_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this inspection type is significantly dependent on favorable weather conditions (e.g., underwater inspections require calm water, detailed visual inspections require good visibility).']

  Note: 'Lookup table defining types of bridge inspections (e.g., routine, special, post‑event, underwater) used to classify inspection records.'
}

Table bridge.inspection_record {
  inspection_record_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique identifier for each bridge inspection event record. This serves as the primary key for the inspection_record product and uniquely identifies each inspection occurrence.']
  bridge_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the bridge that was inspected. Establishes the relationship between the inspection event and the specific bridge asset in the NCDOT inventory.']
  feature_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to gis.feature. Business justification: Links the inspection record to the geographic feature representation of the bridge for spatial analysis and mapping.']
  inspection_type_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the type of inspection performed (routine, fracture-critical, underwater, special, post-event). References the inspection_type product to classify the inspection category.']
  inspector_employee_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to hr.employee. Identifier of the lead inspector or inspection team leader who performed the inspection. Links to the employee record for the responsible inspector.']
  alignment_deviation_observed_indicator boolean [note: 'Indicates whether structural alignment deviation was observed during the inspection. True if horizontal or vertical misalignment is detected.']
  approach_roadway_alignment_rating varchar [note: 'NBIS rating for approach roadway alignment on a scale of 0-9. Evaluates the adequacy of roadway alignment leading to and from the bridge.']
  bearing_condition_rating varchar [note: 'Condition rating for bridge bearings on a scale of 0-9. Evaluates the condition and functionality of bearing assemblies that support the superstructure.']
  bms_data_entry_date date [note: 'Date on which inspection data was entered into the Bridge Management System (BMS). Tracks data processing timeliness.']
  channel_condition_rating varchar [note: 'NBIS condition rating for the channel and channel protection on a scale of 0-9. Evaluates the condition of the waterway channel and erosion protection measures.']
  closure_recommended_indicator boolean [note: 'Indicates whether bridge closure is recommended based on critical structural deficiencies or safety concerns. True if closure is recommended.']
  condition_change_since_last_inspection varchar [note: 'Assessment of condition change since the previous inspection: improved, unchanged, deteriorated, or significantly deteriorated. Tracks condition trends.']
  corrosion_observed_indicator boolean [note: 'Indicates whether corrosion was observed during the inspection on steel or reinforced concrete elements. True if corrosion is present.']
  corrosion_severity varchar [note: 'Severity of observed corrosion: none, light, moderate, severe, or critical. Classifies the extent and impact of corrosion on structural members.']
  cracking_observed_indicator boolean [note: 'Indicates whether cracking was observed in structural members during the inspection. True if cracks are present in concrete or steel components.']
  cracking_type varchar [note: 'Type of cracking observed: flexural, shear, fatigue, thermal, shrinkage, or other. Classifies the crack type to determine cause and structural significance.']
  culvert_condition_rating varchar [note: 'NBIS condition rating for culverts on a scale of 0-9. Assesses the structural and functional condition of culvert structures.']
  debris_accumulation_indicator boolean [note: 'Indicates whether debris accumulation was observed at the bridge, particularly at piers or in the waterway. True if debris is present.']
  debris_description varchar [note: 'Description of debris accumulation, including location, type of debris, and potential impact on bridge hydraulics or structural integrity.']
  deck_condition_rating varchar [note: 'NBIS condition rating for the bridge deck on a scale of 0-9, where 9 is excellent condition and 0 is failed condition. Assesses the condition of the bridge deck surface and structural integrity.']
  deck_geometry_rating varchar [note: 'NBIS rating for deck geometry adequacy on a scale of 0-9. Evaluates whether the deck width, alignment, and geometry meet current standards.']
  defect_code_primary varchar [note: 'Primary defect code identifying the most significant defect observed during inspection. Uses standardized defect coding system for classification.']
  defect_code_secondary varchar [note: 'Secondary defect code identifying additional significant defects observed during inspection. Captures the second most critical defect.']
  defect_extent_description varchar [note: 'Description of the extent or spread of the defect across the structure, including measurements, affected area, and progression since previous inspection.']
  defect_location_description varchar [note: 'Detailed description of the location of observed defects on the bridge structure, including span number, member identification, and specific location details.']
  defect_severity varchar [note: 'Severity classification of the primary defect: minor, moderate, severe, or critical. Indicates the urgency and impact of the identified defect.']
  delamination_observed_indicator boolean [note: 'Indicates whether concrete delamination was observed during the inspection. True if separation of concrete layers is detected.']
  drainage_condition_rating varchar [note: 'Condition rating for bridge drainage systems on a scale of 0-9. Evaluates the condition and effectiveness of deck drainage and scupper systems.']
  emergency_notification_required_indicator boolean [note: 'Indicates whether emergency notification to management or regulatory authorities is required based on critical findings. True if immediate escalation is needed.']
  equipment_used varchar [note: 'Description of specialized equipment used during the inspection (e.g., snooper truck, drone, ultrasonic testing equipment). Documents inspection tools and technology.']
  estimated_repair_cost decimal(12,2) [note: 'Estimated cost in dollars for recommended repairs or actions. Provides preliminary cost estimate for budgeting and prioritization purposes.']
  expansion_joint_condition_rating varchar [note: 'Condition rating for expansion joints on a scale of 0-9. Assesses the condition of joints that accommodate bridge movement due to temperature and loading.']
  federal_aid_eligible_indicator boolean [note: 'Indicates whether repairs or actions recommended from this inspection are eligible for federal aid funding. True if federal funding may be available.']
  findings_summary varchar [note: 'Textual summary of key findings, deficiencies, or notable observations from the inspection. Provides an executive summary of inspection results.']
  fracture_critical_details varchar [note: 'Detailed description of fracture critical members, their location, condition, and any findings from hands-on inspection of FCM components.']
  fracture_critical_indicator boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the bridge contains fracture critical members (FCM) that require special inspection. True if the bridge has tension members whose failure would cause collapse.']
  inspection_compliance_status varchar [note: 'Compliance status of the inspection relative to regulatory requirements and scheduled due dates: compliant, overdue, or early. Tracks adherence to inspection schedules.']
  inspection_date date [note: 'The date on which the bridge or structure inspection was performed. This is the actual field inspection date when the bridge was physically examined.']
  inspection_duration_hours decimal(6,2) [note: 'Total duration of the inspection in hours, from start to completion of field work. Used for resource planning and cost tracking.']
  inspection_frequency_months varchar [note: 'The required frequency of inspection in months based on bridge condition, type, and regulatory requirements. Determines the inspection cycle for the bridge.']
  inspection_method varchar [note: 'Primary method used to conduct the inspection (e.g., visual, hands-on, instrumented, remote). Documents the inspection approach and techniques employed.']
  inspection_notes varchar [note: 'General notes and observations from the inspection that do not fit into other structured fields. Captures additional context and inspector observations.']
  inspection_organization varchar [note: 'The name of the organization or contractor that performed the inspection. Identifies whether the inspection was conducted by NCDOT staff or an external contractor.']
  inspection_report_date date [note: 'Date on which the formal inspection report was completed and finalized. May differ from the inspection date if report preparation takes time.']
  inspection_report_number varchar [note: 'Unique report number or document identifier for the formal inspection report. Links the database record to the official inspection report document.']
  inspection_status varchar [note: 'Current status of the inspection record: scheduled, in progress, completed, under review, or finalized. Tracks inspection workflow status.']
  inspection_team_members varchar [note: 'Names of additional team members who participated in the inspection. Documents the full inspection team composition for accountability and quality assurance purposes.']
  inspection_type varchar [note: 'The type or category of inspection performed (e.g., routine, fracture-critical, underwater, special, in-depth, damage). This is the descriptive text representation of the inspection classification.']
  inspector_certification_expiration_date date [note: 'The expiration date of the inspector\'s certification or license. Used to ensure inspector qualifications are current at the time of inspection.']
  inspector_certification_number varchar [note: 'The certification or license number of the lead inspector who performed the inspection. Validates inspector qualifications and regulatory compliance.']
  inventory_rating_tons decimal(8,2) [note: 'Load level that can be safely supported for an indefinite period of time. Represents the load capacity for long-term structural integrity.']
  lighting_condition_rating varchar [note: 'Condition rating for bridge lighting systems on a scale of 0-9. Assesses the condition and functionality of bridge lighting infrastructure.']
  load_restriction_recommended_indicator boolean [note: 'Indicates whether load restrictions are recommended based on inspection findings and structural capacity analysis. True if posting is recommended.']
  nbi_submittal_date date [note: 'Date on which inspection data was submitted to the National Bridge Inventory. Tracks federal reporting compliance.']
  nbi_submittal_indicator boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this inspection data was submitted to the National Bridge Inventory (NBI) database. True if data was reported to FHWA.']
  next_inspection_due_date date [note: 'The date by which the next inspection must be completed based on regulatory requirements, bridge condition, and inspection frequency. Calculated or assigned date for scheduling future inspections.']
  operating_rating_tons decimal(8,2) [note: 'Maximum permissible live load to which the structure may be subjected for routine use. Represents the load level for normal traffic conditions.']
  overall_condition_rating varchar [note: 'Overall NBIS condition rating for the structure, typically the lowest rating among deck, superstructure, and substructure. Provides a summary assessment of overall bridge condition.']
  paint_coating_condition varchar [note: 'Condition of protective paint or coating on steel members: excellent, good, fair, poor, or failed. Assesses the effectiveness of corrosion protection systems.']
  photo_count varchar [note: 'Number of photographs taken and associated with the inspection record. Quantifies the extent of photographic documentation.']
  photo_documentation_indicator boolean [note: 'Indicates whether photographic documentation was captured during the inspection. True if photos were taken to document conditions.']
  posted_load_limit_tons decimal(6,2) [note: 'Maximum vehicle weight limit in tons if the bridge is posted for load restrictions. Specifies the maximum safe vehicle weight allowed on the bridge.']
  posting_status varchar [note: 'Current posting status of the bridge based on load capacity analysis: open (no restrictions), posted (weight restrictions), or closed. Indicates whether load restrictions are in effect.']
  previous_inspection_date date [note: 'Date of the previous inspection for comparison and trend analysis. Enables tracking of condition changes over time.']
  qa_review_comments varchar [note: 'Comments from the quality assurance reviewer regarding inspection quality, findings, or required corrections. Documents QA feedback.']
  qa_review_date date [note: 'Date on which the quality assurance review was completed. Tracks QA process timeline.']
  qa_review_required_indicator boolean [note: 'Indicates whether quality assurance review of the inspection is required based on bridge criticality or inspection findings. True if QA review is needed.']
  qa_review_status varchar [note: 'Status of the quality assurance review: approved, approved with comments, rejected, or pending revision. Indicates QA outcome.']
  qa_reviewer_name varchar [note: 'Name of the quality assurance reviewer who reviewed the inspection report and findings. Documents QA accountability.']
  railing_condition_rating varchar [note: 'Condition rating for bridge railings on a scale of 0-9. Evaluates the condition and safety adequacy of bridge railings and barriers.']
  recommended_action varchar [note: 'Primary recommended action based on inspection findings: monitor, repair, rehabilitate, replace, or close. Specifies the recommended response to inspection findings.']
  recommended_action_description varchar [note: 'Detailed description of the recommended action, including scope of work, specific repairs needed, and justification based on inspection findings.']
  recommended_action_priority varchar [note: 'Priority level for the recommended action: low, medium, high, or critical. Indicates the urgency of implementing the recommended action.']
  safety_concern_description varchar [note: 'Detailed description of any immediate safety concerns identified during inspection, including nature of the hazard and recommended immediate actions.']
  safety_concern_indicator boolean [note: 'Indicates whether immediate safety concerns were identified during the inspection. True if conditions pose an immediate risk to public safety.']
  scour_condition_rating varchar [note: 'Rating of scour condition at bridge foundations on a scale of 0-9. Assesses the current state of scour at piers and abutments.']
  scour_critical_indicator varchar [note: 'Indicator of scour criticality: Y (scour critical), N (not scour critical), U (unknown), or T (scour critical with temporary monitoring). Identifies bridges at risk of foundation failure due to scour.']
  scour_vulnerability_description varchar [note: 'Detailed description of scour vulnerability, observed scour conditions, and any countermeasures in place. Documents scour risk assessment and mitigation measures.']
  settlement_measurement_inches decimal(6,2) [note: 'Measured settlement in inches, if applicable. Quantifies the amount of vertical displacement observed at foundations or approaches.']
  settlement_observed_indicator boolean [note: 'Indicates whether foundation or approach settlement was observed during the inspection. True if vertical displacement of foundations or approaches is detected.']
  spalling_observed_indicator boolean [note: 'Indicates whether concrete spalling was observed during the inspection. True if concrete surface deterioration with loss of material is present.']
  structural_evaluation varchar [note: 'Detailed narrative evaluation of the structural condition, including assessment of load-carrying capacity, structural integrity, and any concerns identified during inspection.']
  substructure_condition_rating varchar [note: 'NBIS condition rating for the bridge substructure on a scale of 0-9. Assesses the condition of piers, abutments, and other supporting elements below the superstructure.']
  superstructure_condition_rating varchar [note: 'NBIS condition rating for the bridge superstructure on a scale of 0-9. Evaluates the condition of the main load-carrying members above the substructure.']
  temperature_fahrenheit decimal(5,2) [note: 'Ambient temperature in degrees Fahrenheit at the time of inspection. Temperature conditions can affect material behavior and inspection observations.']
  traffic_control_required_indicator boolean [note: 'Indicates whether traffic control measures were required to safely conduct the inspection. True if lane closures or traffic management was needed.']
  traffic_control_type varchar [note: 'Type of traffic control implemented during the inspection (e.g., lane closure, full closure, flagging, temporary signals). Documents traffic management approach.']
  underclearance_horizontal_feet decimal(6,2) [note: 'Minimum horizontal clearance under the bridge in feet. Measures the width available for traffic or waterway passage beneath the bridge.']
  underclearance_vertical_feet decimal(6,2) [note: 'Minimum vertical clearance under the bridge in feet. Critical for determining whether vehicles or vessels can safely pass under the structure.']
  underwater_findings varchar [note: 'Detailed findings from underwater inspection, including condition of submerged piers, footings, scour conditions, and debris accumulation below the waterline.']
  underwater_inspection_indicator boolean [note: 'Indicates whether an underwater inspection was performed as part of this inspection event. True if submerged portions of the bridge were inspected.']
  underwater_inspection_method varchar [note: 'Method used for underwater inspection (e.g., diver inspection, remote operated vehicle, sonar). Documents the technique used to inspect submerged bridge components.']
  vegetation_growth_indicator boolean [note: 'Indicates whether vegetation growth was observed on the bridge structure or approaches. True if vegetation is present that may affect drainage or structural integrity.']
  waterway_adequacy_rating varchar [note: 'NBIS rating for waterway adequacy on a scale of 0-9. Assesses whether the waterway opening is sufficient to pass expected flood flows without causing excessive backwater.']
  weather_conditions varchar [note: 'Description of weather conditions at the time of inspection (e.g., clear, cloudy, rain, fog). Weather can affect inspection visibility and findings.']

  Note: 'This product represents the comprehensive record of bridge inspection events, capturing the execution of specific inspection types on bridges throughout the NCDOT inventory. Each record documents when an inspection occurred, who performed it, detailed condition ratings across all bridge components (deck, superstructure, substructure, channel, culvert), observed defects and their severity, recommended actions, and when the next inspection is due. In NCDOT bridge asset management operations, each bridge undergoes multiple types of inspections throughout its lifecycle (routine, fracture-critical, underwater, special, post-event), with each inspection event carrying specific data about findings, structural evaluations, load ratings, scour conditions, and compliance with National Bridge Inspection Standards (NBIS). This product serves as the single source of truth for all bridge inspection findings, condition assessments, and recommended maintenance actions.'
}

Table traffic.signal_timing_plan {
  signal_timing_plan_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique identifier for the signal timing plan record.']
  atms_system_id varchar [note: 'Identifier of the ATMS system that manages and monitors this signal timing plan.']
  coordination_pattern_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to traffic.coordination_pattern. Business justification: Signal timing plans implement specific coordination patterns for corridor-level signal coordination. This FK links timing plans to their coordination pattern definition, normalizing coordination_mode.']
  signal_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to traffic.signal. Business justification: Signal timing plans must belong to a specific traffic signal controller. This is a fundamental 1:N relationship where one signal has many timing plans (AM peak, PM peak, off-peak, special event, etc.)']

  created_date date [note: 'Date when the signal timing plan record was originally created in the system.']
  cycle_length_seconds varchar [note: 'Total duration of one complete signal cycle in seconds, representing the time from the beginning of one green phase to the beginning of the next identical green phase.']

  last_modified_date date [note: 'Date when the signal timing plan was last modified or updated.']

  maximum_green_time_seconds varchar [note: 'Maximum duration that a green signal can be displayed for actuated phases in seconds before forcing a phase change.']

  offset_seconds varchar [note: 'Time offset in seconds used for signal coordination, representing the time relationship between the start of the local cycle and a system reference point to create green wave progression.']
  peak_hour_factor decimal(4,3) [note: 'Peak hour factor (PHF) representing the ratio of total hourly volume to the peak 15-minute flow rate, used in capacity analysis.']

  phase_1_green_time_seconds varchar [note: 'Duration of green signal display for phase 1 in seconds.']
  phase_1_red_clearance_seconds varchar [note: 'Duration of all-red clearance interval for phase 1 in seconds, providing additional safety time before conflicting movements begin.']
  phase_1_yellow_time_seconds varchar [note: 'Duration of yellow signal display for phase 1 in seconds, providing clearance interval.']
  phase_2_green_time_seconds varchar [note: 'Duration of green signal display for phase 2 in seconds.']
