  phase_3_green_time_seconds varchar [note: 'Duration of green signal display for phase 3 in seconds.']
  phase_3_red_clearance_seconds varchar [note: 'Duration of all-red clearance interval for phase 3 in seconds, providing additional safety time before conflicting movements begin.']
  phase_3_yellow_time_seconds varchar [note: 'Duration of yellow signal display for phase 3 in seconds, providing clearance interval.']
  phase_4_green_time_seconds varchar [note: 'Duration of green signal display for phase 4 in seconds.']
  phase_4_red_clearance_seconds varchar [note: 'Duration of all-red clearance interval for phase 4 in seconds, providing additional safety time before conflicting movements begin.']
  phase_4_yellow_time_seconds varchar [note: 'Duration of yellow signal display for phase 4 in seconds, providing clearance interval.']
  phase_5_green_time_seconds varchar [note: 'Duration of green signal display for phase 5 in seconds.']
  phase_5_red_clearance_seconds varchar [note: 'Duration of all-red clearance interval for phase 5 in seconds, providing additional safety time before conflicting movements begin.']
  phase_5_yellow_time_seconds varchar [note: 'Duration of yellow signal display for phase 5 in seconds, providing clearance interval.']
  phase_6_green_time_seconds varchar [note: 'Duration of green signal display for phase 6 in seconds.']
  phase_6_red_clearance_seconds varchar [note: 'Duration of all-red clearance interval for phase 6 in seconds, providing additional safety time before conflicting movements begin.']
  phase_6_yellow_time_seconds varchar [note: 'Duration of yellow signal display for phase 6 in seconds, providing clearance interval.']
  phase_7_green_time_seconds varchar [note: 'Duration of green signal display for phase 7 in seconds.']
  phase_7_red_clearance_seconds varchar [note: 'Duration of all-red clearance interval for phase 7 in seconds, providing additional safety time before conflicting movements begin.']
  phase_7_yellow_time_seconds varchar [note: 'Duration of yellow signal display for phase 7 in seconds, providing clearance interval.']
  phase_8_green_time_seconds varchar [note: 'Duration of green signal display for phase 8 in seconds.']
  phase_8_red_clearance_seconds varchar [note: 'Duration of all-red clearance interval for phase 8 in seconds, providing additional safety time before conflicting movements begin.']
  phase_8_yellow_time_seconds varchar [note: 'Duration of yellow signal display for phase 8 in seconds, providing clearance interval.']
  phase_sequence varchar [note: 'Ordered sequence of signal phases within the timing plan, typically represented as a comma-separated list of phase numbers (e.g., 2,6,4,8).']
  plan_name varchar [note: 'Descriptive name or label for the signal timing plan (e.g., AM Peak, PM Peak, Weekend, Free).']
  plan_number varchar [note: 'Numeric identifier or code assigned to the timing plan within the traffic signal controller or ATMS.']
  plan_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the timing plan based on operational mode (e.g., time of day, traffic responsive, manual override, coordination, free operation, preemption, transition).']
  preemption_enabled boolean [note: 'Indicates whether emergency vehicle or railroad preemption is enabled for this timing plan.']
  priority_enabled boolean [note: 'Indicates whether transit signal priority is enabled for this timing plan.']
  special_event_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this timing plan is designed for special events such as sports games, concerts, or festivals.']
  split_percentage_phase_1 decimal(5,2) [note: 'Percentage of the total cycle length allocated to phase 1 green time in coordinated operation.']
  split_percentage_phase_2 decimal(5,2) [note: 'Percentage of the total cycle length allocated to phase 2 green time in coordinated operation.']
  split_percentage_phase_3 decimal(5,2) [note: 'Percentage of the total cycle length allocated to phase 3 green time in coordinated operation.']
  split_percentage_phase_4 decimal(5,2) [note: 'Percentage of the total cycle length allocated to phase 4 green time in coordinated operation.']
  split_percentage_phase_5 decimal(5,2) [note: 'Percentage of the total cycle length allocated to phase 5 green time in coordinated operation.']
  split_percentage_phase_6 decimal(5,2) [note: 'Percentage of the total cycle length allocated to phase 6 green time in coordinated operation.']
  split_percentage_phase_7 decimal(5,2) [note: 'Percentage of the total cycle length allocated to phase 7 green time in coordinated operation.']
  split_percentage_phase_8 decimal(5,2) [note: 'Percentage of the total cycle length allocated to phase 8 green time in coordinated operation.']
  status varchar [note: 'Current operational status of the signal timing plan (active, inactive, draft, approved, archived, testing).']
  time_before_reduction_seconds varchar [note: 'Duration in seconds before the controller begins reducing the green extension time in volume-density actuated control.']
  time_of_day_end varchar [note: 'Time of day when this timing plan becomes inactive in HH:MM format (e.g., 09:00 for end of AM peak).']
  time_of_day_start varchar [note: 'Time of day when this timing plan becomes active in HH:MM format (e.g., 07:00 for AM peak).']
  time_to_reduce_seconds varchar [note: 'Rate at which the vehicle extension time is reduced in seconds during gap reduction in actuated control.']
  tmc_region varchar [note: 'Geographic region or district of the TMC responsible for managing this signal timing plan.']
  vehicle_extension_seconds varchar [note: 'Time increment in seconds by which the green phase is extended when a vehicle is detected during actuated operation.']
  version_number varchar [note: 'Version number of the signal timing plan, incremented with each revision or update.']
  weather_responsive_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this timing plan is designed to be activated in response to adverse weather conditions.']

  Note: 'Definition of a signal timing plan (phasing, cycle length, offsets, coordination) that can be applied to a signal controller.'
}

  dispute_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the toll transaction has been disputed by the customer.']
  dispute_reason varchar [note: 'Reason provided by the customer for disputing the toll transaction.']
  dispute_resolution_date date [note: 'Date when the dispute was resolved or closed.']
  distance_traveled decimal(10,3) [note: 'Distance in miles traveled on the toll facility between entry and exit points.']
  due_date date [note: 'Date by which payment is due for invoiced toll transactions.']
  dynamic_pricing_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether dynamic or congestion-based pricing was applied to this transaction.']
  entry_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time when the vehicle entered the toll facility (for distance-based tolling).']
  equipment_status varchar [note: 'Operational status of the toll collection equipment at the time of transaction.']
  exemption_code varchar [note: 'Code indicating the reason for toll exemption if applicable (emergency vehicle, government vehicle, etc.).']
  exemption_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the vehicle was exempt from toll payment.']
  exit_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time when the vehicle exited the toll facility (for distance-based tolling).']
  fiscal_period varchar [note: 'Fiscal period (month) within the fiscal year for financial reporting.']
  fiscal_year varchar [note: 'Fiscal year in which the toll transaction occurred for financial reporting purposes.']
  front_image_url varchar [note: 'Storage location or URL for the front vehicle image captured during the transaction.']
  hov_eligible_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the vehicle met High-Occupancy Vehicle requirements for reduced or waived toll.']
  image_captured_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether photographic evidence was captured for the transaction (typically for video tolling or violations).']
  lane_type varchar [note: 'Type of toll collection lane (electronic, manual, mixed mode, express, or high-occupancy vehicle).']
  license_plate_number varchar [note: 'Vehicle license plate number captured by automated license plate recognition system or manual entry.']
  license_plate_state varchar [note: 'State or jurisdiction that issued the vehicle license plate.']
  milepost decimal(10,3) [note: 'Milepost location on the route where the toll transaction occurred.']
  notes varchar [note: 'Free-text notes or comments about the transaction for operational or customer service purposes.']
  occupancy_count varchar [note: 'Number of occupants detected in the vehicle, used for High-Occupancy Vehicle (HOV) lane enforcement.']
  payment_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time when payment was processed or received for the toll transaction.']
  posted_date date [note: 'Date when the transaction was posted to the customer account or financial system.']
  rear_image_url varchar [note: 'Storage location or URL for the rear vehicle image (license plate) captured during the transaction.']
  refund_amount decimal(10,2) [note: 'Amount refunded to the customer if the transaction was reversed or adjusted.']
  refund_date date [note: 'Date when the refund was processed.']
  revenue_category varchar [note: 'Revenue classification category for financial reporting and analysis.']
  revenue_recognition_date date [note: 'Date when the toll revenue was recognized in the financial system per GASB standards.']
  route_id varchar [note: 'Highway or roadway route identifier where the toll was collected.']
  route_name varchar [note: 'Common name or designation of the toll route or facility.']
  source_system varchar [note: 'Source system or application that generated the toll transaction record.']
  surcharge_amount decimal(10,2) [note: 'Additional surcharge applied to the transaction (e.g., video toll surcharge, administrative fee).']
  time_of_day_period varchar [note: 'Time period classification for dynamic toll pricing (peak, off-peak, overnight, weekend).']
  toll_amount decimal(10,2) [note: 'Base toll amount charged for the transaction before any adjustments, discounts, or fees.']
  toll_plaza_name varchar [note: 'Business name or location description of the toll plaza.']
  total_amount decimal(10,2) [note: 'Total amount charged for the toll transaction including base toll, discounts, and surcharges.']
  transaction_date date [note: 'Calendar date of the toll transaction, used for daily reporting and reconciliation.']
  transaction_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Precise date and time when the toll transaction was recorded at the collection point.']
  transaction_type varchar [note: 'Type of toll transaction (revenue collection, violation, test transaction, adjustment, or reversal).']
  transponder_agency varchar [note: 'Agency or toll authority that issued the electronic toll collection transponder.']
  trip_duration_minutes varchar [note: 'Duration of the trip on the toll facility in minutes, calculated from entry to exit.']
  vehicle_class varchar [note: 'Vehicle classification code used for toll rate determination (e.g., Class 1-9 based on axle count and vehicle type).']
  vehicle_identifier varchar [note: 'Unique identifier for the vehicle that passed through the toll point. May be license plate, transponder ID, or other vehicle identification method.']
  vehicle_speed decimal(5,2) [note: 'Speed of the vehicle in miles per hour when passing through the toll point.']
  vehicle_weight decimal(10,2) [note: 'Gross vehicle weight in pounds captured by weigh-in-motion sensors, if available.']
  violation_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the transaction represents a toll violation (vehicle passed without valid payment).']
  violation_type varchar [note: 'Type of toll violation if applicable (no transponder, insufficient funds, unreadable plate, etc.).']

  Note: 'Transactional record of toll collections: vehicle identifier, toll plaza, lane, amount, payment method, and collection timestamp. Also consolidates: highway.toll_transaction, traffic.toll_transaction.'
}

  vehicle_class_description varchar [note: 'Detailed description of the vehicle class (e.g., \'Passenger Cars\', \'Two-Axle Six-Tire Single Unit Trucks\', \'Multi-Trailer Trucks\').']

Table traffic.coordination_pattern {

  coordination_mode varchar [note: 'Operating mode that defines how traffic signals interact within this pattern (free-running, coordinated progression, actuated response, etc.).']
  cycle_length_seconds varchar [note: 'Total duration of one complete signal cycle in seconds for this coordination pattern, typically ranging from 60 to 180 seconds.']
  days_of_week varchar [note: 'Comma-separated list of days when this pattern is active (e.g., Monday,Tuesday,Wednesday,Thursday,Friday for weekday patterns).']
  description varchar [note: 'Detailed description of the coordination pattern including its purpose, traffic conditions it addresses, and operational characteristics.']
  effective_date date [note: 'Date when this coordination pattern was first implemented or became effective for traffic operations.']
  expiration_date date [note: 'Date when this coordination pattern is scheduled to be retired or replaced, if applicable.']
  incident_response_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this pattern is designed for incident management and can be triggered by IMAP (Incident Management Assistance Patrol) events.']
  last_modified_date date [note: 'Date when the coordination pattern configuration was last updated or modified.']
  name varchar [note: 'Descriptive name of the coordination pattern (e.g., AM Peak, PM Peak, Weekend, Special Event).']
  notes varchar [note: 'Additional operational notes, implementation guidance, or special instructions for traffic engineers and TMC operators.']
  offset_reference_seconds varchar [note: 'Time offset in seconds from the master reference point used to synchronize signals along the coordinated corridor.']
  pattern_code varchar [note: 'Short alphanumeric code used to identify the coordination pattern in traffic management systems and field operations.']
  pattern_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the coordination pattern based on its triggering mechanism and operational context.']
  priority_direction varchar [note: 'Primary traffic flow direction that receives coordination priority and optimized green wave progression in this pattern.']
  priority_level varchar [note: 'Numeric priority ranking (1=highest) used to resolve conflicts when multiple patterns are eligible for activation simultaneously.']
  special_event_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this pattern is designed for special events such as sporting events, concerts, or planned road closures.']
  status varchar [note: 'Current operational status of the coordination pattern indicating whether it is available for deployment in the traffic management system.']
  target_speed_mph varchar [note: 'Design speed in miles per hour used to calculate signal timing offsets for optimal vehicle progression through the corridor.']
  time_of_day_end varchar [note: 'End time in HH:MM format (24-hour clock) when this coordination pattern is scheduled to terminate.']
  time_of_day_start varchar [note: 'Start time in HH:MM format (24-hour clock) when this coordination pattern becomes active during scheduled operations.']
  tmc_approval_required boolean [note: 'Flag indicating whether TMC operator approval is required before this pattern can be activated.']
  version_number varchar [note: 'Version identifier for the coordination pattern configuration, incremented with each modification to maintain change history.']

  Note: 'Master reference table for coordination_pattern. Referenced by coordination_pattern_id.'
}

  milepost decimal(8,3) [note: 'Milepost location along the route where the issue is located.']
  mitigation_strategy varchar [note: 'Strategy or approach used to mitigate the issue and reduce its impact.']
  number varchar [note: 'Human-readable unique issue number assigned to the project issue for tracking and reference purposes.']
  preventive_action varchar [note: 'Preventive measures or process improvements implemented to avoid similar issues in the future.']
  priority varchar [note: 'Priority ranking assigned to the issue for resolution sequencing and resource allocation.']
  project_phase varchar [note: 'Phase of the project lifecycle during which the issue was identified (e.g., Preliminary Engineering, Construction Engineering, Right-of-Way).']
  public_involvement_required_flag boolean [note: 'Indicator of whether the issue requires public notification, engagement, or hearing.']
  recurrence_flag boolean [note: 'Indicator of whether this issue is a recurrence of a previously resolved issue.']
  regulatory_compliance_flag boolean [note: 'Indicator of whether the issue involves regulatory compliance concerns or violations.']
  related_issue_number varchar [note: 'Reference number of any related or parent issue, if this is a recurrence or dependent issue.']
  related_rfi_number varchar [note: 'Reference number of any Request for Information associated with this issue.']
  reported_by varchar [note: 'Name of the individual or role who identified and reported the issue.']
  reported_by_organization varchar [note: 'Organization or division of the individual who reported the issue (e.g., Division of Highways, contractor, consultant).']
  reported_date date [note: 'Date when the issue was first identified and reported into the system.']
  requires_design_change_flag boolean [note: 'Indicator of whether the issue requires a design modification or revision.']
  requires_permit_modification_flag boolean [note: 'Indicator of whether the issue requires modification of environmental or regulatory permits.']
  resolution_description varchar [note: 'Detailed narrative describing the actions taken to resolve the issue and the final outcome.']

  root_cause varchar [note: 'Identified root cause of the issue based on investigation and analysis.']
  route_number varchar [note: 'Highway route number where the issue is located (e.g., US-1, NC-55, I-40).']
  sap_wbs_element varchar [note: 'SAP Project System WBS element code identifying the specific project component affected by the issue.']

  severity varchar [note: 'Severity level indicating the impact and urgency of the issue on project delivery and objectives.']
  source_system varchar [note: 'System of record where the issue was originally created and managed.']
  source_system_id varchar [note: 'Unique identifier of the issue in the source system of record.']
  stakeholder_notification_date date [note: 'Date when relevant stakeholders were notified of the issue.']
  status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the issue indicating its progression through the resolution workflow.']
  target_resolution_date date [note: 'Planned or committed date by which the issue is expected to be resolved.']
  title varchar [note: 'Brief descriptive title or subject line summarizing the project issue.']
  type varchar [note: 'Classification of the issue by its primary nature or domain (e.g., technical, schedule, budget, safety, environmental).']
  verification_date date [note: 'Date when the issue resolution was verified and validated.']
  verification_method varchar [note: 'Method used to verify that the issue has been properly resolved.']
  verified_by varchar [note: 'Name of the individual who verified that the issue was properly resolved.']
  work_breakdown_structure_code varchar [note: 'Work Breakdown Structure code identifying the specific project component or work package affected by the issue.']

  Note: 'Transactional log of project issues, including description, severity, owner, resolution steps, and closure date.'
}

  probability_score decimal(5,2) [note: 'Numerical probability score representing the likelihood of risk occurrence, typically on a scale (e.g., 0.0 to 1.0 or 1 to 10).']

  response_strategy varchar [note: 'Planned risk response strategy (e.g., avoid, mitigate, transfer, accept, escalate for threats; exploit, share, enhance for opportunities).']
  review_frequency varchar [note: 'Planned frequency for reviewing and reassessing this risk (e.g., daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, as needed).']
  row_acquisition_risk_flag boolean [note: 'Indicator of whether this risk is related to right-of-way acquisition, property negotiations, or condemnation proceedings.']
  schedule_impact_days varchar [note: 'Estimated number of days the project schedule could be delayed if this risk materializes.']
  scope_impact_description varchar [note: 'Description of how the risk could affect project scope, deliverables, or quality if it occurs.']
  score decimal(10,2) [note: 'Overall risk score calculated from probability and impact (typically probability_score × impact_score) to prioritize risks.']
  source varchar [note: 'Origin or source of the risk identification (e.g., risk workshop, project team, stakeholder input, historical data, audit finding).']
  source_record_id varchar [note: 'Unique identifier of the risk record in the source system for traceability and reconciliation.']
  source_system varchar [note: 'System of record where the risk data originated (e.g., SAP PS, HiCAMS, NCDOT Connect, SharePoint, manual entry).']
  status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the risk (e.g., identified, assessed, active, mitigated, closed, accepted, transferred, escalated, monitoring).']

  subcategory varchar [note: 'More granular classification within the risk category to provide additional context for risk analysis and reporting.']
  title varchar [note: 'Brief descriptive title or name of the identified risk.']
  utility_coordination_risk_flag boolean [note: 'Indicator of whether this risk is related to utility relocation, coordination, or conflicts.']

  Note: 'Transactional record of identified project risks, probability, impact, mitigation actions, and status.'
}

  notification_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this stakeholder must receive formal notifications for project milestones, public hearings, or status changes per regulatory or policy requirements']
  stakeholder_role varchar [note: 'The specific role this stakeholder plays in this project (e.g., Consulting Party, Affected Property Owner, Utility Coordinator, MPO Representative, Funding Partner, Advisory Board Member)']
  created_by varchar [note: 'User ID or name of the person who created this engagement record']

  Note: 'This association product represents the formal engagement relationship between a transportation project and a stakeholder entity. It captures the stakeholder\'s role, engagement requirements, notification obligations, and approval authority for each specific project. Each record links one project to one stakeholder with attributes that exist only in the context of this project-stakeholder relationship.. Existence Justification: In NCDOT transportation project delivery, projects routinely engage multiple stakeholders (MPOs, RPOs, local governments, utilities, property owners, regulatory agencies, community groups), and each stakeholder entity participates in multiple projects across their jurisdiction or area of interest. Public involvement coordinators and project managers actively manage these engagement relationships, tracking each stakeholder\'s specific role, required engagement level, notification obligations, and approval authority on a per-project basis for regulatory compliance (NEPA, SEPA, federal aid requirements) and coordination purposes.'
}

  vessel_registration_number varchar [note: 'Official registration or documentation number for the vessel as assigned by the United States Coast Guard (USCG).']
  visibility_miles decimal(5,2) [note: 'Visibility distance at the time of sailing, measured in statute miles.']
  wave_height_feet decimal(5,2) [note: 'Significant wave height at the time of sailing, measured in feet.']
  weather_alert_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether a weather alert or advisory is in effect that may impact this sailing.']
  weather_condition_code varchar [note: 'Code representing the forecasted or actual weather conditions for this sailing.']
  wind_speed_knots decimal(5,2) [note: 'Wind speed at the time of sailing, measured in knots.']

  Note: 'Planned sailing instances for a given route, including departure/arrival times, assigned vessel, and available capacity.'
}

  weekday_service_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the route operates on weekdays (Monday through Friday).']
  wheelchair_accessible_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the route is fully wheelchair accessible in compliance with ADA requirements.']

  Note: 'Master record for each transit route, including route identifier, short and long names, type (bus, rail, ferry), and operational attributes. Also consolidates: ferry.route, transit.route.'
}

Table transit.fare {
  fare_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique identifier for the fare structure record. Primary key for the fare reference data.']
  accounts_receivable_invoice_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to finance.accounts_receivable_invoice. Business justification: Fare revenue collected from transit riders must be invoiced and recorded in accounts receivable. Finance department uses this to track transit service revenue and reconcile collections daily.']
  grant_program_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to grant.program. Business justification: Fare structures are often dictated by grant program requirements (e.g., reduced fares for elderly/disabled under FTA programs). Finance tracks program-specific fare policies for compliance audits.']
  route_id varchar [note: 'Specific route identifier if this fare structure applies to a particular route. Null indicates system-wide applicability.']
  vendor_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to procurement.vendor. Business justification: Fare collection systems and ticketing equipment provided by vendors. Finance and operations teams track vendor for maintenance contracts, system upgrades, and technical support of fare collection infr']
  zone_id varchar [note: 'Identifier for the fare zone or geographic area where this fare structure applies. Used for zone-based pricing models.']
  ada_compliant_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this fare structure complies with ADA requirements for accessible transportation services.']
  base_fare_amount decimal(10,2) [note: 'The standard fare amount in US dollars before any discounts, surcharges, or zone adjustments are applied.']
  board_approval_date date [note: 'Date when the fare structure was officially approved by the transit agency governing board.']
  bulk_purchase_discount_percentage decimal(5,2) [note: 'Percentage discount applied when purchasing multiple rides or passes in bulk.']
  bulk_purchase_quantity varchar [note: 'Number of rides or passes included in a bulk purchase package (e.g., 10-ride ticket book).']
  cap_daily_amount decimal(10,2) [note: 'Maximum total fare amount a rider will pay in a single day, after which additional trips are free. Null indicates no daily cap.']
  cap_monthly_amount decimal(10,2) [note: 'Maximum total fare amount a rider will pay in a single month, after which additional trips are free. Null indicates no monthly cap.']
  cap_weekly_amount decimal(10,2) [note: 'Maximum total fare amount a rider will pay in a single week, after which additional trips are free. Null indicates no weekly cap.']
  code varchar [note: 'Business-assigned unique code identifying the fare type or structure. Used for operational reference and reporting.']
  currency_code varchar [note: 'ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for fare amounts. Typically USD for North Carolina transit systems.']
  description varchar [note: 'Detailed description of the fare structure, including eligibility criteria, usage restrictions, and applicable conditions.']
  destination_zone varchar [note: 'Ending zone for zone-to-zone fare structures. Used in distance-based or multi-zone pricing models.']
  discount_amount decimal(10,2) [note: 'Fixed dollar amount discount applied to the base fare for eligible riders.']
  discount_percentage decimal(5,2) [note: 'Percentage discount applied to the base fare for eligible rider categories (e.g., 50% for seniors, 25% for students).']
  distance_maximum_miles decimal(8,2) [note: 'Maximum trip distance in miles covered by this fare structure. Longer trips may require additional fare payment.']
  distance_minimum_miles decimal(8,2) [note: 'Minimum trip distance in miles for distance-based fare structures. Trips shorter than this distance use the base fare.']
  distance_rate_per_mile decimal(10,4) [note: 'Fare rate charged per mile of travel for distance-based pricing models.']
  eligibility_documentation_required varchar [note: 'Description of documentation required to prove eligibility for this fare category (e.g., \'Valid student ID\', \'Medicare card\', \'Disability certification\').']
  equity_analysis_date date [note: 'Date when the most recent fare equity analysis was conducted for Title VI compliance review.']
  final_fare_amount decimal(10,2) [note: 'The actual fare amount charged to the rider after all discounts and adjustments are applied.']
  fta_fare_category_code varchar [note: 'Standardized FTA fare category code used for National Transit Database reporting and federal grant compliance.']
  holiday_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this fare structure applies on designated holidays.']
  last_revision_date date [note: 'Date when this fare structure was last modified or updated.']
  maximum_age varchar [note: 'Maximum age in years for eligibility to use this fare structure (e.g., youth fares typically end at age 18).']
  media_type varchar [note: 'Physical or digital medium used to store and validate the fare.']
  minimum_age varchar [note: 'Minimum age in years required for eligibility to use this fare structure.']
  name varchar [note: 'Descriptive name of the fare structure (e.g., \'Adult Single Ride\', \'Senior Monthly Pass\', \'Student Discount Fare\').']
  off_peak_period_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this fare structure applies during off-peak travel periods.']
  origin_zone varchar [note: 'Starting zone for zone-to-zone fare structures. Used in distance-based or multi-zone pricing models.']
  payment_method varchar [note: 'Accepted payment instrument or method for purchasing this fare type.']
  peak_period_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this fare structure applies during peak travel periods (typically weekday rush hours).']
  promotional_code varchar [note: 'Special code associated with promotional or limited-time fare offerings.']
  promotional_end_date date [note: 'End date for promotional fare offerings or special pricing periods.']
  promotional_start_date date [note: 'Start date for promotional fare offerings or special pricing periods.']
  public_hearing_date date [note: 'Date when public hearing was held for fare structure changes, as required by FTA regulations.']
  purchase_channel varchar [note: 'Distribution channel or location where this fare can be purchased.']
  refundable_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether unused or partially used fares of this type can be refunded to the customer.']
  revenue_allocation_code varchar [note: 'Accounting code used to allocate fare revenue to appropriate cost centers, funding sources, or financial accounts.']
  rider_category varchar [note: 'Classification of eligible riders for this fare structure based on demographic or eligibility criteria.']
  route_name varchar [note: 'Name of the specific route if this fare structure is route-specific.']
  service_type varchar [note: 'Type of transit service to which this fare structure applies.']
  status varchar [note: 'Current operational status of the fare structure within the transit system.']
  subsidy_percentage decimal(5,2) [note: 'Percentage of the fare amount covered by subsidy funding rather than rider payment.']
  subsidy_source varchar [note: 'Source of subsidy funding that reduces the fare amount for eligible riders (e.g., FTA grants, state transit assistance, employer programs).']
  title_vi_compliant_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this fare structure has been reviewed and approved for compliance with Title VI Civil Rights Act requirements prohibiting discrimination.']
  transfer_allowed_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this fare structure permits transfers to other routes or modes within the transit system.']
  transfer_count_limit varchar [note: 'Maximum number of transfers permitted under this fare structure within the transfer validity window.']
  transfer_fee_amount decimal(10,2) [note: 'Additional fee charged for each transfer, if applicable. Zero indicates free transfers.']
  transfer_time_limit_minutes varchar [note: 'Time window in minutes during which transfers are valid after initial fare payment.']
  transferable_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this fare can be transferred or shared between different riders.']
  type varchar [note: 'Classification of the fare structure based on usage pattern and validity period.']
  validity_end_date date [note: 'Date when this fare structure expires and is no longer available for purchase or use. Null indicates indefinite validity.']
  validity_period_days varchar [note: 'Number of consecutive days the fare is valid from the date of purchase or first use (e.g., 1 for day pass, 30 for monthly pass).']
  validity_start_date date [note: 'Date when this fare structure becomes effective and available for use.']
  weekend_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this fare structure is valid for weekend travel (Saturday and Sunday).']

  Note: 'Reference data defining fare structures, zones, rider categories, discounts, and transfer rules for the transit system. Also consolidates: ferry.fare, transit.fare.'
}

  purchase_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time when the ticket was purchased or issued, in format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.']

  refund_amount decimal(10,2) [note: 'Amount refunded to the customer for cancelled or unused tickets. Denominated in US dollars.']
  refund_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time when the refund was processed, in format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.']
  reservation_number varchar [note: 'Unique reservation identifier for advance-booking services such as ferry reservations or paratransit trips.']
  route_name varchar [note: 'Descriptive name of the transit route or ferry service associated with the ticket.']
  route_number varchar [note: 'Transit route number or ferry route identifier associated with the ticket. May be null for system-wide passes.']
  service_area varchar [note: 'Geographic service area or region covered by the ticket (county, city, regional district).']
  service_type varchar [note: 'Mode of transportation service provided by the ticket, indicating the type of transit or ferry service.']
  smart_card_number varchar [note: 'Unique identifier of the smart card or fare media used for the ticket. Used for contactless payment systems and reloadable fare cards.']
  special_accommodation varchar [note: 'Description of special accommodations requested or provided (wheelchair, service animal, mobility device, etc.).']
  status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the ticket, indicating whether it is available for use, has been used, or is no longer valid.']
  subsidy_amount decimal(10,2) [note: 'Dollar amount of subsidy applied to the ticket from federal, state, or local assistance programs. Denominated in US dollars.']

  transfer_count varchar [note: 'Number of transfers allowed or used with this ticket. May be null for unlimited transfer passes.']
  trip_date date [note: 'Scheduled date of travel for the ticket, in format yyyy-MM-dd. For single-ride tickets with specific trip reservations.']
  trip_time varchar [note: 'Scheduled departure time for the trip. For ferry reservations and scheduled transit services.']
  type varchar [note: 'Classification of the ticket product purchased, indicating fare category and validity period. Includes both transit and ferry ticket types as this product consolidates ferry.ticket and transit.ticket.']
  valid_from_date date [note: 'Start date of the ticket validity period, in format yyyy-MM-dd. For passes and multi-day tickets.']
  valid_to_date date [note: 'End date of the ticket validity period, in format yyyy-MM-dd. For passes and multi-day tickets.']
  validation_location varchar [note: 'Physical location where the ticket was validated (station name, vehicle number, terminal).']
  validation_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time when the ticket was first validated or activated for use, in format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. May be null for unused tickets.']
  vehicle_length_feet decimal(5,2) [note: 'Length of vehicle being transported on ferry, measured in feet. Used for ferry capacity planning and fare calculation for oversized vehicles.']
  vehicle_type varchar [note: 'Type of vehicle being transported on ferry service. Primarily applicable to ferry tickets. Null for transit-only tickets.']
  zone_destination varchar [note: 'Fare zone identifier for the destination location. Used in zone-based fare systems.']
  zone_origin varchar [note: 'Fare zone identifier for the origin location. Used in zone-based fare systems.']

  Note: 'Transactional record of a ticket purchase or validation, capturing rider, fare applied, payment method, and timestamp. Also consolidates: ferry.ticket, transit.ticket.'
}

Table transit.route_stop_schedule {
  route_stop_schedule_id varchar [pk, note: 'Primary key for the route_stop_schedule association']
  route_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the transit route that serves this stop']
  stop_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the transit stop that is served by this route']
  arrival_time varchar [note: 'The scheduled time when the transit vehicle arrives at this stop on this route. Format HH:MM:SS. Used for passenger information and schedule adherence monitoring.']
  departure_time varchar [note: 'The scheduled time when the transit vehicle departs from this stop on this route. Format HH:MM:SS. May differ from arrival_time for timing points where vehicles wait.']
  drop_off_type varchar [note: 'Indicates drop-off availability at this stop for this route: 0=regularly scheduled, 1=no drop-off available, 2=must phone agency, 3=must coordinate with driver. Route-stop specific operational rule.']
  pickup_type varchar [note: 'Indicates pickup availability at this stop for this route: 0=regularly scheduled, 1=no pickup available, 2=must phone agency, 3=must coordinate with driver. Route-stop specific operational rule.']
  shape_dist_traveled decimal(10,2) [note: 'The distance traveled along the route shape from the origin to this stop, measured in miles or kilometers. Used for accurate map rendering and distance-based fare calculation for this specific route-stop combination.']
  stop_sequence varchar [note: 'The order in which this stop is visited along the route. Critical for trip planning and schedule display. Lower numbers indicate earlier stops in the route sequence.']
  timepoint_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this stop is a designated timepoint where the vehicle must adhere to exact scheduled times (true) or an approximate stop (false). Critical for operations and schedule adherence reporting.']

  Note: 'This association product represents the scheduled service relationship between transit routes and stops. It captures the operational schedule defining which stops are served by which routes, in what sequence, and at what times. Each record links one route to one stop with scheduling attributes that exist only in the context of this specific route-stop pairing. This is the foundational data structure for trip planning, schedule adherence monitoring, and service coverage analysis.. Existence Justification: In transit operations, routes serve multiple stops and stops are served by multiple routes. This is the fundamental operational relationship in public transportation, explicitly managed through schedule planning processes. Transit planners actively create, update, and delete route-stop assignments during service planning cycles, and each assignment carries critical scheduling data (sequence, arrival/departure times, pickup/drop-off rules) that belongs to neither the route nor the stop alone.'
}

  service_start_date date [note: 'Date when the transit service first began operations or is scheduled to begin.']
  service_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the transit service mode based on operational characteristics and service delivery model.']
  status varchar [note: 'Current operational status of the transit service indicating whether it is actively running, temporarily suspended, or permanently discontinued.']

  feed_type varchar [note: 'Type of GTFS feed indicating whether it contains static schedule data, real-time updates, or both.']
  feed_url varchar [note: 'Direct URL where the GTFS feed data file can be downloaded or accessed.']
  feed_version varchar [note: 'Version identifier for the GTFS feed, used to track updates and changes to the transit data over time.']
  fta_grant_program varchar [note: 'FTA grant program identifier associated with funding for the transit services represented in this GTFS feed.']
  last_updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp indicating when the GTFS feed data was last updated or refreshed.']
  mpo_rpo_affiliation varchar [note: 'Name of the MPO or RPO planning organization coordinating with this transit service for regional transportation planning.']

  transit_agency_name varchar [note: 'Name of the primary transit agency or operator whose services are represented in this GTFS feed.']

  Note: 'Master reference table for gtfs_feed. Referenced by gtfs_feed_id.'
}

Table transit.direction {
  direction_id varchar [pk, note: 'Primary key for direction']
  code varchar [note: 'Standard abbreviated code representing the direction (e.g., N, S, E, W, NE, NW, SE, SW, NB, SB, EB, WB). Used for compact representation in transit route and schedule systems.']
  compass_bearing decimal(5,2) [note: 'Numeric compass bearing in degrees (0-360) representing the direction. 0/360 = North, 90 = East, 180 = South, 270 = West. Used for precise geographic orientation in GIS and route planning systems.']
  description varchar [note: 'Detailed description of the direction including context for transit operations, such as \'Toward downtown\' or \'Away from city center\'. Provides additional clarity for route planning and passenger information.']
  display_order varchar [note: 'Numeric sequence used to control the display order of directions in user interfaces, reports, and public transit information systems. Lower numbers appear first.']
  effective_date date [note: 'Date when this direction reference became effective and available for use in transit route and schedule planning. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.']
  expiration_date date [note: 'Date when this direction reference expires or is no longer valid for use in active transit operations. Null indicates no expiration. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.']
  gtfs_direction_id varchar [note: 'GTFS-compliant direction identifier used in transit feed specifications. Binary value where 0 typically represents one direction (e.g., outbound) and 1 represents the opposite direction (e.g., inbound). Required for GTFS data exchange with trip planning applications.']
  is_primary boolean [note: 'Boolean flag indicating whether this is a primary direction for route planning. Primary directions (e.g., Northbound, Southbound) are typically used for major route designations, while secondary directions may be used for branches or variants.']
  name varchar [note: 'Full descriptive name of the direction (e.g., Northbound, Southbound, Eastbound, Westbound, Inbound, Outbound). Used for display in public-facing transit schedules and route maps.']
  notes varchar [note: 'Additional notes, comments, or special instructions related to the direction. May include usage guidelines, regional variations, or coordination requirements with Metropolitan Planning Organization (MPO) or Regional Planning Organization (RPO) partners.']
  opposite_direction_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the direction_id of the opposite or return direction. For example, if this record is Northbound, this field would reference the direction_id for Southbound. Used for bidirectional route planning and schedule coordination.']
  status varchar [note: 'Current operational status of the direction reference value. Active directions are in use for current transit operations, inactive are temporarily not in use, and deprecated are retained for historical reference only.']
  type varchar [note: 'Classification of the direction type. Cardinal (N/S/E/W), Ordinal (NE/NW/SE/SW), Inbound/Outbound (relative to central point), Loop (circular route), or Circular (continuous circuit).']

  Note: 'Master reference table for direction. Referenced by direction_id.'
}

  protection_zone_base_end_acres decimal(8,2) [note: 'The area of the Runway Protection Zone at the base end, measured in acres, which is a trapezoidal area intended to enhance safety.']

  remarks varchar [note: 'Additional notes, comments, or special information about the runway not captured in other fields.']
  safety_area_length_base_end_ft varchar [note: 'The length of the Runway Safety Area extending beyond the base end threshold.']
  safety_area_length_reciprocal_end_ft varchar [note: 'The length of the Runway Safety Area extending beyond the reciprocal end threshold.']
  safety_area_width_ft varchar [note: 'The width of the Runway Safety Area, a defined surface surrounding the runway prepared to reduce risk of damage to aircraft in case of undershoot, overshoot, or excursion.']
  snow_removal_equipment_available boolean [note: 'Indicates whether dedicated snow removal equipment is available for this runway.']
  surface_condition varchar [note: 'The current assessed condition of the runway surface based on inspection and maintenance records.']
  surface_treatment varchar [note: 'Special surface treatment applied to enhance friction, drainage, or performance characteristics.']
  surface_type varchar [note: 'The primary material composition of the runway surface.']
  touchdown_zone_lighting boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the runway is equipped with touchdown zone lighting to enhance visibility during approach and landing.']
  true_bearing_base_end decimal(5,2) [note: 'The true (geographic) azimuth bearing of the base end runway centerline in degrees (0-360).']
  true_bearing_reciprocal_end decimal(5,2) [note: 'The true (geographic) azimuth bearing of the reciprocal end runway centerline in degrees (0-360).']
  visibility_value_base_end_ft varchar [note: 'The minimum visibility in feet required for operations at the base end under instrument meteorological conditions.']
  visibility_value_reciprocal_end_ft varchar [note: 'The minimum visibility in feet required for operations at the reciprocal end under instrument meteorological conditions.']
  visual_glide_slope_indicator_base_end varchar [note: 'The type of visual approach slope indicator system installed at the base end (e.g., VASI, PAPI).']
  visual_glide_slope_indicator_reciprocal_end varchar [note: 'The type of visual approach slope indicator system installed at the reciprocal end (e.g., VASI, PAPI).']
  weight_bearing_capacity_dual_tandem_lbs varchar [note: 'The maximum weight in pounds that the runway pavement can support for aircraft with dual tandem landing gear configuration.']
  weight_bearing_capacity_dual_wheel_lbs varchar [note: 'The maximum weight in pounds that the runway pavement can support for aircraft with dual wheel landing gear configuration.']
  weight_bearing_capacity_single_wheel_lbs varchar [note: 'The maximum weight in pounds that the runway pavement can support for aircraft with single wheel landing gear configuration.']
  width_ft varchar [note: 'The physical width of the runway pavement measured in feet.']
  wildlife_hazard_mitigation boolean [note: 'Indicates whether a wildlife hazard mitigation program is in place for this runway.']

  Note: 'Physical characteristics of each runway (length, width, surface type, lighting, thresholds).'
}

  dinghies_count varchar [note: 'Count of inflatable dinghies or life rafts carried on board the aircraft.']
  emergency_locator_transmitter boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the aircraft is equipped with an emergency locator transmitter.']
  estimated_arrival_time timestamp [note: 'Updated estimated arrival time based on current flight conditions and routing in UTC.']
  estimated_departure_time timestamp [note: 'Updated estimated departure time based on current conditions and delays in UTC.']
  estimated_flight_time_minutes varchar [note: 'Estimated total flight time from departure to arrival measured in minutes.']
  faa_flight_plan_number varchar [note: 'Official FAA-assigned flight plan number used for tracking and coordination with air traffic control.']
  filed_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time when the flight plan was officially filed with the FAA.']
  filing_organization varchar [note: 'Name of the organization or operator that filed the flight plan.']
  flight_rules varchar [note: 'Type of flight rules under which the flight will operate: IFR (Instrument Flight Rules), VFR (Visual Flight Rules), DVFR (Defense Visual Flight Rules), or SVFR (Special Visual Flight Rules).']
  flight_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the flight purpose and operational category.']
  fuel_on_board_gallons decimal(10,2) [note: 'Total fuel quantity loaded on the aircraft measured in gallons.']
  fuel_on_board_hours decimal(5,2) [note: 'Total fuel available on the aircraft expressed in hours of flight time at cruise consumption rate.']
  fuel_on_board_pounds decimal(10,2) [note: 'Total fuel weight loaded on the aircraft measured in pounds.']
  hazardous_materials_on_board boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the aircraft is carrying hazardous materials requiring special handling.']
  hazmat_description varchar [note: 'Description of hazardous materials being transported including UN numbers and classifications.']
  home_base_airport_code varchar [note: 'ICAO or FAA airport identifier code for the aircraft\'s home base or primary operating location.']
  icao_flight_plan_format boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the flight plan was filed using ICAO standard format versus FAA domestic format.']
  international_flight boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the flight crosses international borders requiring customs and immigration procedures.']
  last_amended_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time of the most recent amendment to the flight plan.']
  life_jackets_on_board boolean [note: 'Indicates whether life jackets are available on board for all occupants.']
  navigation_equipment varchar [note: 'ICAO equipment codes indicating navigation and communication equipment on board (e.g., GPS, VOR, DME, ILS).']
  notam_references varchar [note: 'Reference numbers for relevant NOTAMs affecting the flight route or airports.']
  number_of_crew varchar [note: 'Total count of crew members operating the aircraft for this flight.']
  number_of_passengers varchar [note: 'Total count of passengers on board the aircraft for this flight.']
  operator_address varchar [note: 'Mailing address of the aircraft operator or registered owner.']
  operator_contact_phone varchar [note: 'Primary contact phone number for the aircraft operator or flight coordinator.']
  operator_name varchar [note: 'Name of the individual or organization operating the aircraft for this flight.']
  overwater_flight boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the flight route includes extended overwater segments.']
  performance_based_navigation_capable boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the aircraft is equipped and certified for Performance Based Navigation procedures.']
  pilot_contact_phone varchar [note: 'Primary contact phone number for the pilot in command.']
  pilot_in_command_license_number varchar [note: 'FAA-issued pilot certificate number for the pilot in command.']
  pilot_in_command_name varchar [note: 'Full name of the pilot in command responsible for the flight operation.']
  priority_code varchar [note: 'Priority classification for air traffic control handling and sequencing.']
  remarks varchar [note: 'Additional remarks, notes, or special instructions related to the flight plan.']
  route_description varchar [note: 'Detailed textual description of the planned flight route including waypoints, airways, and navigation fixes.']
  rvsm_approved boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the aircraft is approved for operations in Reduced Vertical Separation Minimum airspace.']
  scheduled_arrival_time timestamp [note: 'Planned date and time of arrival at the destination airport in UTC.']
  scheduled_departure_time timestamp [note: 'Planned date and time of departure from the origin airport in UTC.']
  search_and_rescue_info varchar [note: 'Contact information and details for search and rescue coordination in case of emergency.']
  source varchar [note: 'Origin or method by which the flight plan was submitted to the FAA.']
  special_handling_codes varchar [note: 'Codes indicating special handling requirements such as medical emergency, law enforcement, or VIP transport.']
  status varchar [note: 'Current status of the flight plan in the air traffic control system.']
  surveillance_equipment varchar [note: 'ICAO equipment codes indicating surveillance equipment such as ADS-B, ADS-C, or Mode S.']
  survival_equipment varchar [note: 'Description of survival and emergency equipment carried on the aircraft (e.g., life rafts, ELT, survival kits).']
  tfr_applicable boolean [note: 'Indicates whether any Temporary Flight Restrictions apply to the planned route.']
  tfr_authorization_number varchar [note: 'Authorization number if special permission was granted to operate within a TFR area.']
  transponder_code varchar [note: 'Four-digit octal code assigned to the aircraft transponder for radar identification.']
  transponder_type varchar [note: 'Type of transponder equipment installed on the aircraft.']
  version varchar [note: 'Version number tracking the current iteration of the flight plan including all amendments.']
  wake_turbulence_category varchar [note: 'FAA wake turbulence classification based on aircraft maximum takeoff weight.']
  weather_conditions_departure varchar [note: 'Weather category at departure airport: VFR (Visual Flight Rules), MVFR (Marginal VFR), IFR (Instrument Flight Rules), or LIFR (Low IFR).']
  weather_conditions_destination varchar [note: 'Weather category at destination airport: VFR, MVFR, IFR, or LIFR.']

  Note: 'Submitted flight plan details for each flight, including route, altitude, fuel, and aircraft performance data.'
}

  rate_schedule_code varchar [note: 'Code identifying the specific rate schedule or tariff applied to calculate the fee.']
  recorded_by varchar [note: 'Name or identifier of the staff member who recorded the fee transaction.']
  refund_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Amount refunded to the airline if the fee was reversed or adjusted.']
  refund_date date [note: 'Date when the refund was processed and issued to the airline.']
  service_date date [note: 'Date when the airport service was actually provided to the airline.']
  source_system varchar [note: 'Name or identifier of the operational system from which the fee transaction data originated.']
  source_transaction_reference varchar [note: 'Original transaction identifier from the source operational system.']
  surcharge_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Additional surcharge amount added to the base fee (e.g., peak hour surcharges, fuel surcharges).']
  tax_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Total tax amount applied to the airport fee transaction.']
  terminal_name varchar [note: 'Name or identifier of the airport terminal where services were provided.']

  waiver_approval_date date [note: 'Date when the fee waiver or reduction was officially approved.']
  waiver_approved_by varchar [note: 'Name or identifier of the authority who approved the fee waiver or reduction.']
  waiver_reason varchar [note: 'Explanation or justification if the fee was waived or reduced from standard rates.']

  Note: 'Transactional records of fees charged to airlines for landing, parking, terminal use, and other airport services.'
}

  Note: 'Master records of pilot licenses issued, renewed, or revoked, with holder qualifications and medical status.'
}

  road_name varchar [note: 'Official name or designation of the public or private road that crosses the railroad tracks.']
  road_number varchar [note: 'Official route number or designation for the roadway (e.g., US-1, NC-55, SR-401).']
  road_surface_type varchar [note: 'Type of road surface material at the crossing: paved (asphalt/concrete), gravel, dirt, or other.']
  school_bus_stop_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether school buses are required to stop at this crossing before proceeding.']
  section_130_eligible boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the crossing is eligible for federal Section 130 Railway-Highway Crossings Program funding.']
  sight_distance_adequate boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the sight distance at the crossing meets minimum safety standards for drivers to see approaching trains.']
  sight_distance_feet varchar [note: 'Measured sight distance in feet from the roadway approach to the railroad tracks, used to assess visibility of approaching trains.']
  stop_sign_present boolean [note: 'Indicates whether a stop sign is installed at the crossing requiring vehicles to stop before proceeding.']
  track_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the railroad track at the crossing: main line, siding, yard track, industry track, or other.']
  train_count_per_day varchar [note: 'Average number of trains passing through the crossing per day.']
  train_speed_max_mph varchar [note: 'Maximum authorized speed for trains at this crossing location, measured in miles per hour.']
  train_type varchar [note: 'Primary type of train service using this crossing: freight only, passenger only, mixed (both freight and passenger), or other.']

  Note: 'Master list of at‑grade railroad crossings, with crossing ID, location, protection type (gate, signal), road classification, and safety status.'
}

  positive_train_control_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether Positive Train Control (PTC) system is required on tracks of this classification per federal mandate.']
  requires_concrete_ties boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this track classification requires concrete crossties rather than wood ties for enhanced durability and track stability.']
  requires_continuous_welded_rail boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this track classification requires continuous welded rail (CWR) construction rather than jointed rail for improved ride quality and reduced maintenance.']
  signal_system_requirement varchar [note: 'Type of signal system required for safe operations on this track classification (e.g., none, manual block, automatic block, cab signal, positive train control).']
  speed_restriction_threshold_mph varchar [note: 'Speed in miles per hour to which operations must be restricted when track geometry or condition falls below acceptable standards but does not require immediate service suspension.']
  standard_gauge_inches decimal(5,3) [note: 'Standard track gauge measurement in inches for this classification. In North America, standard gauge is 56.5 inches (4 feet 8.5 inches).']
  status varchar [note: 'Current status of this track classification reference record indicating whether it is actively used for regulatory compliance.']
  superelevation_max_inches decimal(5,2) [note: 'Maximum allowable superelevation (banking) in inches on curved track sections for this classification to balance centrifugal forces.']

  vegetation_control_requirement varchar [note: 'Level of vegetation control required along the right-of-way for this track classification to maintain visibility and prevent track degradation.']

  Note: 'Reference codes defining track classes (Class 1‑6) based on speed limits, track geometry, and maintenance standards.'

Table rail.track_inspection {
  track_inspection_id varchar [pk, note: 'Primary key for the track_inspection association']
  employee_id varchar [note: 'Identifier of the inspector who examined this specific track segment during the inspection']
  safety_inspection_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the safety inspection event']
  track_segment_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the track segment being inspected']
  compliance_status varchar [note: 'Compliance status of this track segment based on inspection findings']
  corrective_action_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether corrective action is required for this track segment based on inspection findings']
  defect_description varchar [note: 'Detailed description of defects found on this track segment during inspection']
  defects_found varchar [note: 'Number of defects identified on this track segment during the inspection']
  inspection_date date [note: 'Date when this specific track segment was inspected during the safety inspection event']
  inspection_type varchar [note: 'Type of inspection performed on this track segment (geometry, rail condition, tie condition, etc.)']
  priority varchar [note: 'Priority level for addressing defects found on this track segment']
  segment_end_milepost decimal(10,3) [note: 'Ending milepost of the portion of track segment inspected (may be subset of full segment)']
  segment_start_milepost decimal(10,3) [note: 'Starting milepost of the portion of track segment inspected (may be subset of full segment)']

  Note: 'This association product represents the Event of a safety inspection being performed on a specific track segment. It captures the inspection findings, compliance status, and defects identified for each track segment during each inspection. Each record links one track segment to one safety inspection with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific inspection-segment relationship.. Existence Justification: In rail operations, track segments undergo multiple safety inspections over time (geometry checks, rail condition assessments, tie inspections), and each safety inspection event typically covers multiple contiguous track segments along a line or subdivision. The business actively manages inspection-segment pairings as operational records, tracking specific findings, compliance status, and defect counts for each segment during each inspection. This is a true operational M:N relationship where the inspection-segment pairing carries meaningful data.'
}

  track_closure_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the work zone requires complete closure of rail track during work activities.']

  zone_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the work zone activity type indicating the nature of rail work being performed.']

  Note: 'Master reference table for work_zone. Referenced by work_zone_id.'
}

Table asset.condition {
  condition_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique identifier for the asset condition rating record. Primary key for the condition data product.']
  action_required varchar [note: 'Type of maintenance or management action typically required when an asset is rated at this condition level.']
  action_timeframe_days varchar [note: 'Recommended timeframe in days within which maintenance action should be taken for assets at this condition level.']
  category varchar [note: 'The category of asset to which this condition rating applies (e.g., pavement, bridge, structure, facility, equipment, vehicle).']
  code varchar [note: 'Standardized code representing the condition rating level (e.g., EXC, GOOD, FAIR, POOR, FAIL). Used across asset management systems for consistent condition classification.']
  color_code varchar [note: 'Hexadecimal color code used for visual representation of this condition rating in dashboards, maps, and reports (e.g., #00FF00 for green/good condition).']
  depreciation_rate_annual decimal(5,4) [note: 'Annual depreciation rate (as decimal) typically applied to assets at this condition level for financial accounting purposes.']
  description varchar [note: 'Detailed description of what the condition rating represents, including criteria and characteristics that define this condition level.']
  effective_date date [note: 'Date on which this condition rating definition became effective and available for use in asset assessments.']
  estimated_remaining_life_years varchar [note: 'Typical estimated remaining service life in years for assets at this condition level, used for lifecycle planning and replacement forecasting.']
  expiration_date date [note: 'Date on which this condition rating definition expires or was superseded by a new definition. Null if currently active.']
  federal_reporting_code varchar [note: 'Standardized code used for federal reporting to FHWA, FTA, or other federal agencies. Maps internal condition ratings to federal reporting requirements.']
  funding_priority varchar [note: 'Priority level (1-10) for funding allocation to assets at this condition level. Lower numbers indicate higher priority for capital investment.']
  gasb_34_category varchar [note: 'GASB 34 condition category for infrastructure asset reporting. Used for financial reporting of capital assets under modified approach.']
  hpms_condition_type varchar [note: 'HPMS condition classification (Good, Fair, Poor) used for federal reporting. Required for National Highway System reporting to FHWA.']
  icon_name varchar [note: 'Name or identifier of the icon used to represent this condition rating in user interfaces and mapping applications.']
  iri_max decimal(6,2) [note: 'Maximum International Roughness Index value (inches per mile) associated with this pavement condition rating. IRI measures pavement surface roughness and ride quality.']
  iri_min decimal(6,2) [note: 'Minimum International Roughness Index value (inches per mile) associated with this pavement condition rating. IRI measures pavement surface roughness and ride quality.']
  is_active boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this condition rating is currently active and available for use in asset assessments. Inactive ratings are retained for historical reference.']
  is_default boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this is the default condition rating to be applied when no specific assessment has been performed.']
  maintenance_cost_factor decimal(5,2) [note: 'Multiplier factor representing the relative maintenance cost for assets at this condition level compared to baseline. Used for budget forecasting.']
  name varchar [note: 'Human-readable name of the condition rating (e.g., Excellent, Good, Fair, Poor, Failed).']
  nbi_rating varchar [note: 'National Bridge Inventory condition rating code (0-9 or N) for bridge components. Used for federal bridge condition reporting.']
  numeric_rating decimal(5,2) [note: 'Numeric representation of the condition rating on a standardized scale. Enables quantitative analysis and trending of asset condition over time.']
  pci_max decimal(5,2) [note: 'Maximum Pavement Condition Index value (0-100 scale) associated with this pavement condition rating. PCI is a numerical rating of pavement surface surface condition.']
  pci_min decimal(5,2) [note: 'Minimum Pavement Condition Index value (0-100 scale) associated with this pavement condition rating. PCI is a numerical rating of pavement surface condition.']
  psi_max decimal(4,2) [note: 'Maximum Present Serviceability Index value (0-5 scale) associated with this pavement condition rating. PSI measures the ability of pavement to serve traffic.']
  psi_min decimal(4,2) [note: 'Minimum Present Serviceability Index value (0-5 scale) associated with this pavement condition rating. PSI measures the ability of pavement to serve traffic.']
  public_notification_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether assets at this condition level require public notification or posting of warnings (e.g., bridge weight restrictions, road condition advisories).']
  rating_scale_max decimal(5,2) [note: 'Maximum value of the rating scale used for this condition type (e.g., 100 for a 0-100 scale, 10 for a 1-10 scale).']
  rating_scale_min decimal(5,2) [note: 'Minimum value of the rating scale used for this condition type (e.g., 0 for a 0-100 scale, 1 for a 1-10 scale).']
  replacement_threshold boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this condition level represents the threshold at which asset replacement should be considered rather than continued maintenance.']
  requires_inspection boolean [note: 'Indicates whether assets at this condition level require formal inspection or assessment by qualified personnel.']
  safety_concern boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this condition level represents a safety concern requiring immediate attention or public notification.']
  severity_level varchar [note: 'Severity classification indicating the urgency of maintenance or replacement needs associated with this condition rating.']
  sort_order varchar [note: 'Numeric value used to control the display order of condition ratings in user interfaces, reports, and dropdown lists. Lower values appear first.']
  source_system varchar [note: 'System of record where this condition rating is defined and maintained (e.g., SAP PM, ATLAS, Agile Assets, Bridge Management System, Pavement Management System).']
  source_system_id varchar [note: 'Unique identifier for this condition rating in the source system of record. Used for data lineage and reconciliation.']
  sufficiency_rating_max decimal(5,2) [note: 'Maximum bridge sufficiency rating (0-100 scale) associated with this condition level. Sufficiency rating evaluates bridge adequacy and safety.']

  threshold_upper decimal(5,2) [note: 'Upper boundary threshold value that defines the maximum numeric rating for this condition level. Assets with ratings below or at this value fall into this condition category.']

  Note: 'Standard condition codes used to rate asset health (e.g., excellent, good, fair, poor) based on IRI, PCI, etc.'

  route_direction varchar [note: 'Primary directional orientation of the route (North, South, East, West, or combinations for diagonal routes, Bidirectional for routes without specific direction, Loop for circular routes).']

  Note: 'Master reference table for route. Referenced by route_id.'
