  actual_start_date date [note: 'Actual date when mitigation activities commenced.']
  adaptive_management_required boolean [note: 'Indicator of whether adaptive management approach is required to adjust mitigation activities based on monitoring results.']
  approval_authority varchar [note: 'Name of the regulatory authority or official who approved the mitigation plan.']
  approval_date date [note: 'Date when the mitigation plan was officially approved by the regulatory agency.']
  conservation_easement_required boolean [note: 'Indicator of whether a conservation easement or deed restriction is required to protect the mitigation site in perpetuity.']
  contingency_plan varchar [note: 'Description of contingency measures to be implemented if initial mitigation activities fail to meet success criteria.']
  coordination_agency_1 varchar [note: 'Name of the first regulatory or resource agency requiring coordination for this mitigation plan (e.g., USACE, NCDEQ, USFWS).']
  coordination_agency_2 varchar [note: 'Name of the second regulatory or resource agency requiring coordination for this mitigation plan.']
  coordination_agency_3 varchar [note: 'Name of the third regulatory or resource agency requiring coordination for this mitigation plan.']
  corrective_action_deadline date [note: 'Deadline date by which corrective actions must be completed.']
  corrective_action_description varchar [note: 'Description of corrective actions required to address deficiencies or non-compliance identified during monitoring.']
  corrective_action_required boolean [note: 'Indicator of whether corrective actions are required based on inspection findings or monitoring results.']
  created_date date [note: 'Date when the mitigation plan record was created in the system.']
  credit_cost_per_unit decimal(12,2) [note: 'Cost per mitigation credit purchased from a mitigation bank or in-lieu fee program.']
  document_repository_path varchar [note: 'File path or URL to the document repository location where mitigation plan documentation is stored (e.g., SharePoint, ProjectWise).']
  easement_holder varchar [note: 'Name of the organization or entity holding the conservation easement for the mitigation site (e.g., land trust, government agency).']
  environmental_justice_consideration varchar [note: 'Description of environmental justice considerations and how the mitigation plan addresses impacts to minority or low-income populations.']
  estimated_cost_amount decimal(15,2) [note: 'Estimated total cost for implementing the mitigation plan including construction, monitoring, and administrative costs.']
  federal_fiscal_year varchar [note: 'Federal fiscal year in which mitigation activities are planned or funded (format: FY2024).']
  federal_funding_program varchar [note: 'Name of the federal funding program supporting mitigation costs, if applicable (e.g., FHWA, FTA, BUILD, INFRA).']
  funding_source varchar [note: 'Primary source of funding for mitigation activities (e.g., state funds, federal highway funds, mitigation bank credits, in-lieu fee program).']
  impact_area_acres decimal(12,4) [note: 'Total area of environmental impact measured in acres (e.g., acres of wetland affected, acres of habitat disturbed).']
  impact_linear_feet decimal(12,2) [note: 'Linear measurement of environmental impact in feet (e.g., feet of stream affected, feet of right-of-way disturbance).']
  impact_magnitude varchar [note: 'Qualitative assessment of the severity or magnitude of the environmental impact being mitigated.']
  impact_type varchar [note: 'Category of environmental impact being mitigated (e.g., wetland loss, stream disturbance, endangered species habitat, historic site disturbance).']
  inspection_findings varchar [note: 'Summary of findings from the most recent inspection or monitoring visit, including compliance status and any deficiencies noted.']
  last_inspection_date date [note: 'Date of the most recent inspection or monitoring visit to the mitigation site.']
  last_modified_date date [note: 'Date when the mitigation plan record was last modified or updated.']
  long_term_management_plan varchar [note: 'Description of the long-term management plan for the mitigation site after the monitoring period ends, including maintenance responsibilities and funding mechanisms.']
  mitigation_action varchar [note: 'Detailed description of the specific mitigation action or measure to be implemented to offset the identified environmental impact.']
  mitigation_area_acres decimal(12,4) [note: 'Total area of mitigation activity measured in acres (e.g., acres of wetland created, acres of habitat restored).']
  mitigation_bank_name varchar [note: 'Name of the mitigation bank used to satisfy mitigation requirements, if applicable.']
  mitigation_county varchar [note: 'North Carolina county where the mitigation activities will take place.']
  mitigation_credits_purchased decimal(10,4) [note: 'Number of mitigation credits purchased from a mitigation bank or in-lieu fee program to satisfy mitigation requirements.']
  mitigation_latitude decimal(10,7) [note: 'Latitude coordinate of the mitigation site location in decimal degrees.']
  mitigation_linear_feet decimal(12,2) [note: 'Linear measurement of mitigation activity in feet (e.g., feet of stream restored, feet of buffer established).']
  mitigation_location varchar [note: 'Geographic description or address of the location where mitigation activities will be performed.']
  mitigation_longitude decimal(10,7) [note: 'Longitude coordinate of the mitigation site location in decimal degrees.']
  mitigation_ratio decimal(5,2) [note: 'Ratio of mitigation area to impact area (e.g., 2:1 ratio means 2 acres of mitigation for every 1 acre of impact).']
  mitigation_type varchar [note: 'Primary mitigation strategy employed: avoidance (preventing impact), minimization (reducing impact), rectification (repairing impact), reduction (limiting impact over time), compensation (offsetting impact), restoration (returning to original condition), creation (establishing new resource), enhancement (improving existing resource), preservation (protecting existing resource), or monitoring (tracking impact).']
  monitoring_criteria varchar [note: 'Specific measurable criteria that must be met to demonstrate successful mitigation (e.g., vegetation survival rates, water quality parameters, species population targets).']
  monitoring_duration_years varchar [note: 'Required duration of post-implementation monitoring in years (e.g., 5-year monitoring period for wetland mitigation).']
  monitoring_end_date date [note: 'Date when post-implementation monitoring period is scheduled to end.']
  monitoring_frequency varchar [note: 'Frequency at which monitoring activities must be conducted during the monitoring period.']
  monitoring_start_date date [note: 'Date when post-implementation monitoring period begins.']
  next_inspection_date date [note: 'Date of the next scheduled inspection or monitoring visit to the mitigation site.']
  notes varchar [note: 'Additional notes, comments, or special considerations related to the mitigation plan.']
  performance_bond_amount decimal(15,2) [note: 'Dollar amount of the performance bond required to guarantee mitigation completion.']
  performance_bond_required boolean [note: 'Indicator of whether a performance bond is required to guarantee completion of mitigation activities.']
  permit_issuing_agency varchar [note: 'Government agency that issued the environmental permit requiring this mitigation (e.g., USACE - US Army Corps of Engineers, NCDEQ - NC Department of Environmental Quality, EPA - Environmental Protection Agency, USFWS - US Fish and Wildlife Service, SHPO - State Historic Preservation Office).']
  permit_number varchar [note: 'Reference number of the environmental permit that requires this mitigation plan.']
  permit_type varchar [note: 'Type of environmental permit associated with this mitigation plan (e.g., Section 404 Clean Water Act permit, Section 401 Water Quality Certification, Endangered Species Act consultation, Section 106 Historic Preservation).']
  plan_description varchar [note: 'Comprehensive description of the mitigation plan including objectives, scope, and overall approach to offsetting environmental impacts.']
  plan_number varchar [note: 'Business-assigned unique plan number for tracking and reference purposes across environmental compliance documentation.']
  plan_status varchar [note: 'Current status of the mitigation plan in its lifecycle: draft (being developed), submitted (under review), approved (authorized for implementation), in_progress (actively being implemented), completed (implementation finished), monitoring (post-implementation monitoring phase), closed (all requirements satisfied), suspended (temporarily halted), cancelled (no longer required).']
  plan_title varchar [note: 'Descriptive title of the mitigation plan identifying the primary environmental impact being addressed.']
  planned_completion_date date [note: 'Scheduled date for completing all mitigation activities.']
  planned_start_date date [note: 'Scheduled date for beginning implementation of mitigation activities.']
  project_number varchar [note: 'NCDOT project identifier for the transportation project requiring this mitigation plan.']
  public_comment_period_end date [note: 'End date of the public comment period for this mitigation plan, if applicable.']
  public_comment_period_start date [note: 'Start date of the public comment period for this mitigation plan, if applicable.']
  public_involvement_required boolean [note: 'Indicator of whether public involvement or public comment period is required for this mitigation plan.']
  regulatory_agency_contact varchar [note: 'Name of the primary contact at the regulatory agency overseeing this mitigation plan.']
  responsible_division varchar [note: 'NCDOT division responsible for overseeing implementation of the mitigation plan (e.g., Division of Highways, Environmental Analysis Unit).']
  responsible_party varchar [note: 'Name of the organization or entity responsible for implementing the mitigation plan (e.g., NCDOT, contractor, third-party mitigation bank).']
  state_fiscal_year varchar [note: 'State fiscal year in which mitigation activities are planned or funded (format: FY2024).']
  success_criteria_met boolean [note: 'Indicator of whether the mitigation plan has met all defined success criteria.']

  Note: 'Master record describing mitigation measures required to offset identified environmental impacts, including actions, responsible parties, schedule, and monitoring criteria.'
}

  hazmat_material_type varchar [note: 'Type or classification of hazardous material involved in the incident response.']
  hsip_eligible_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the incident location is eligible for HSIP safety improvements.']
  incident_commander_name varchar [note: 'Name of the incident commander who coordinated the overall response effort.']
  injury_reported_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether injuries were reported during the incident requiring medical response.']
  lanes_closed_count varchar [note: 'Number of traffic lanes closed as part of the response action.']
  latitude decimal(10,7) [note: 'Latitude coordinate of the response action location.']

  longitude decimal(10,7) [note: 'Longitude coordinate of the response action location.']
  materials_used varchar [note: 'Description of materials consumed or deployed during the response (e.g., absorbent, cones, signs).']
  media_coverage_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the incident and response received media coverage.']
  milepost decimal(10,3) [note: 'Milepost location on the route where the response action occurred.']
  notes varchar [note: 'Additional notes or comments regarding the response action.']
  personnel_count varchar [note: 'Number of personnel involved in executing the response action.']
  priority_level varchar [note: 'Priority level assigned to the response action based on incident severity and impact.']
  public_notification_method varchar [note: 'Method used to notify the public about the incident and response actions.']
  queue_length_miles decimal(10,2) [note: 'Maximum length of traffic queue in miles resulting from the incident.']

  record_updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time when the response action record was last updated.']

  resource_type varchar [note: 'Type of resource or equipment deployed for the response action.']
  responder_contact_number varchar [note: 'Contact phone number of the responder for coordination purposes.']
  responder_name varchar [note: 'Name of the primary responder or team leader who executed the response action.']
  responding_agency varchar [note: 'The primary agency or organization responsible for this response action.']
  response_effectiveness_rating varchar [note: 'Qualitative rating of the effectiveness of the response action.']
  response_time_minutes decimal(10,2) [note: 'Total time in minutes from dispatch to arrival on scene.']
  road_closure_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether a full road closure was required for the response action.']
  roadway_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the roadway where the response action took place.']
  route_number varchar [note: 'Highway or route number where the response action took place.']
  secondary_incident_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether a secondary incident occurred during the response action.']
  special_event_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the response was related to a special event or planned activity.']
  tmc_notification_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time when the TMC was notified of the incident and response.']
  tmc_notified_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the Traffic Management Center was notified of the response action.']
  traffic_control_method varchar [note: 'Method of traffic control implemented during the response action.']
  traffic_volume_impact varchar [note: 'Estimated impact of the incident and response on traffic volume and flow.']
  visibility_condition varchar [note: 'Lighting and visibility conditions at the time of the response action.']
  weather_condition varchar [note: 'Weather conditions present during the response action execution.']

  Note: 'Actions taken by emergency responders and NCDOT personnel in response to a safety incident, including dispatch, resources used, and timestamps.'

  regulatory_requirement varchar [note: 'Specific regulatory requirement, standard, or code that mandates or drives the corrective action (e.g., OSHA regulation, FHWA standard, MUTCD requirement).']
  responsible_division varchar [note: 'NCDOT division or organizational unit responsible for implementing the corrective action (e.g., DOH, DMV, Ferry Division, Aviation Division).']
  responsible_party_email varchar [note: 'Email address of the responsible party for communication and notification regarding the corrective action.']
  responsible_party_name varchar [note: 'Name of the individual, team, or organizational unit assigned responsibility for implementing and completing the corrective action.']
  responsible_party_phone varchar [note: 'Contact phone number for the responsible party assigned to the corrective action.']
  responsible_unit varchar [note: 'Specific unit, section, or work group within the responsible division assigned to execute the corrective action.']
  risk_score varchar [note: 'Quantitative risk score (1-100) assigned to the safety issue based on likelihood and severity, used for prioritization.']
  root_cause varchar [note: 'Identified root cause of the safety issue or incident that the corrective action is designed to address, based on investigation findings.']
  route_number varchar [note: 'Highway or route number where the corrective action is to be implemented, if applicable to roadway infrastructure.']
  severity_level varchar [note: 'Severity level of the safety issue or hazard that the corrective action addresses, based on potential consequences.']
  source_reference_number varchar [note: 'Reference identifier of the originating inspection, incident, audit, or other source event that generated this corrective action.']
  source_type varchar [note: 'Type of source event or activity that generated the corrective action requirement.']
  status varchar [note: 'Current status of the corrective action in its lifecycle from identification through closure.']
  title varchar [note: 'Brief descriptive title or summary of the corrective action for quick identification and reporting purposes.']
  type varchar [note: 'Classification of the corrective action based on timing and nature of the response required.']
  verification_method varchar [note: 'Method used to verify and validate that the corrective action was properly implemented and effective.']
  verification_notes varchar [note: 'Notes documenting the verification process, findings, and confirmation that the corrective action adequately addressed the identified issue.']
  verified_by_name varchar [note: 'Name of the individual who performed the verification and validation of the completed corrective action.']
  verified_date date [note: 'Date when the completed corrective action was verified and validated as effective by the reviewing authority.']

  Note: 'Corrective actions generated from safety inspections or incident investigations, tracking action ID, description, responsible party, due date, status, and closure details.'
}

Table planning.plan_status {

  is_active boolean [note: 'Boolean flag indicating whether this status represents an active state where work is ongoing on the transportation plan.']
  is_terminal boolean [note: 'Boolean flag indicating whether this status represents a final state from which no further status transitions are expected (e.g., Approved, Archived, Cancelled).']
  last_modified_date date [note: 'Date when this plan status record was most recently updated or modified.']
  mpo_coordination_required boolean [note: 'Boolean flag indicating whether plans in this status require coordination with Metropolitan Planning Organizations.']
  notes varchar [note: 'Additional notes, guidance, or instructions related to this plan status. May include procedural information or special handling requirements.']
  notification_required boolean [note: 'Boolean flag indicating whether stakeholders must be notified when a plan transitions to this status.']
  plan_type_applicability varchar [note: 'Comma-separated list of plan types to which this status applies (e.g., Long Range Transportation Plan (LRTP), Comprehensive Transportation Plan (CTP), State Transportation Improvement Program (STIP), Transportation Improvement Program (TIP)).']
  public_comment_period_required boolean [note: 'Boolean flag indicating whether plans in this status must undergo a public comment period before advancing to the next status.']
  public_visibility boolean [note: 'Boolean flag indicating whether plans in this status are visible to the public through citizen-facing portals and websites.']
  requires_approval boolean [note: 'Boolean flag indicating whether plans in this status require formal approval before transitioning to the next status.']
  rpo_coordination_required boolean [note: 'Boolean flag indicating whether plans in this status require coordination with Rural Planning Organizations.']
  sla_duration_days varchar [note: 'Target number of days within which plans in this status should be processed or transitioned, as defined by service level agreements or business rules.']
  status_category varchar [note: 'High-level categorization of the status type. Active statuses indicate ongoing work, inactive indicates no current activity, transitional indicates status changes in progress, terminal indicates final states.']
  status_code varchar [note: 'Short alphanumeric code representing the plan status. Used as a lookup key in operational systems and reports.']
  status_description varchar [note: 'Detailed description of what the plan status represents, including business rules and conditions for when this status applies.']
  status_name varchar [note: 'Full descriptive name of the plan status. Human-readable label for the status.']
  status_usage_count varchar [note: 'Total number of transportation plans that have been assigned this status historically. Used for analytics and status utilization reporting.']
  workflow_stage varchar [note: 'The stage in the transportation planning workflow that this status represents (e.g., Initiation, Development, Review, Approval, Implementation, Closeout).']

  Note: 'Reference table of possible statuses for a transportation plan (e.g., Draft, Approved, In‑Review, Archived) with status code and description.'

Table planning.corridor_segment {
  corridor_segment_id varchar [pk, note: 'Primary key for the corridor_segment association']
  corridor_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the planning corridor that includes this segment']
  segment_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the highway segment that is included in the corridor']
  effective_date date [note: 'Date when the current status became effective. Used with status to track the lifecycle of segment membership in corridors over time.']
  inclusion_date date [note: 'Date when this segment was officially included in the corridor definition. Supports historical tracking of corridor boundary changes and is used in corridor study documentation and planning history.']
  milepost_end decimal(10,3) [note: 'Ending milepost of this segment within the corridor\'s milepost system. Used with milepost_start to define the segment\'s extent within the corridor for corridor-level analysis and project limits definition.']
  milepost_start decimal(10,3) [note: 'Starting milepost of this segment within the corridor\'s milepost system. May differ from the segment\'s route-based milepoint as corridors can span multiple routes and use corridor-specific milepost references.']
  notes varchar [note: 'Free-text notes documenting special considerations, rationale for inclusion, or planning context specific to this segment\'s membership in this corridor.']
  segment_role varchar [note: 'Functional role of this segment within the corridor context (e.g., Primary mainline, Alternate route, Parallel facility, Connector, Future extension). Used for corridor analysis to distinguish between core corridor segments and supporting facilities.']
  sequence_order varchar [note: 'Sequential position of this segment within the corridor, used for ordering segments along the corridor path for analysis and reporting. Critical for phased improvement planning where projects are sequenced along the corridor.']
  status varchar [note: 'Current status of this segment\'s membership in the corridor. Supports corridor boundary refinement processes where segments may be proposed for inclusion, under review, or removed from corridor definitions.']

  Note: 'This association product represents the membership relationship between highway segments and planning corridors. It captures the inclusion of specific highway segments within defined transportation corridors for planning, analysis, and phased improvement tracking. Each record links one segment to one corridor with attributes that define the segment\'s position and role within that corridor context.. Existence Justification: In NCDOT planning operations, highway segments are operational assets that can belong to multiple overlapping planning corridors simultaneously (e.g., a segment of US-1 may be part of the US-1 Strategic Corridor, the Triangle Regional Freight Corridor, and the Capital Area Mobility Corridor). Conversely, planning corridors are multi-segment constructs that span dozens to hundreds of segments for corridor-level analysis, STIP project development, and phased improvement planning. Planners actively manage these segment-corridor memberships, tracking each segment\'s position, role, and inclusion status within each corridor context.'
}

  created_by varchar [note: 'User ID or name of the person who created the task in the master list.']

  Note: 'Master list of predefined maintenance tasks (e.g., pothole patch, vegetation control, snow removal) with standard labor codes, estimated duration, and required materials.'
}

  acquisition_request_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to rightofway.acquisition_request. Table maintenance.assignment {
  assignment_id varchar [pk, note: 'Primary key for the assignment association']
  crew_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the maintenance crew assigned to perform work on the highway segment']
  segment_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the highway segment where maintenance work is to be performed']
  task_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to maintenance.task. Business justification: Assignment should reference the specific task being performed. This enables task-level tracking of crew assignments. Work_type is task attribute.']
  work_order_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to maintenance.work_order. Business justification: Assignment.work_order_number (STRING) should be normalized to FK reference to work_order. This links crew-segment assignments to work orders. Priority is work_order attribute.']
  actual_cost decimal(12,2) [note: 'Actual cost incurred in dollars for this crew assignment after work completion. Used for budget tracking and cost analysis.']
  completion_date date [note: 'The date when the crew completed the assigned maintenance work on the segment. Used for performance tracking and historical records.']
  date date [note: 'The date when the crew was assigned to perform maintenance work on the segment. This is the scheduled or actual start date of the maintenance activity.']
  duration_days decimal(6,2) [note: 'The planned or actual duration of the maintenance assignment measured in days. Represents how long the crew is expected to work on this segment.']
  estimated_cost decimal(12,2) [note: 'Estimated cost in dollars for this specific crew assignment, including labor, equipment, and materials for the work on this segment.']
  notes varchar [note: 'Free-text notes or comments about the assignment, including special conditions, issues encountered, or additional context about the maintenance work performed.']
  role varchar [note: 'The role or capacity in which the crew is assigned to this segment (e.g., Primary crew responsible for the work, Support crew assisting another crew, Emergency Response, Specialized work requiring specific certifications).']
  status varchar [note: 'Current operational status of the crew assignment (e.g., Scheduled, In Progress, Completed, Cancelled, On Hold). Tracks the lifecycle of the maintenance assignment.']

  Note: 'This association product represents the operational assignment of maintenance crews to highway segments for specific maintenance work. It captures the work scheduling, crew deployment, and maintenance activity tracking that occurs when NCDOT assigns crews to perform maintenance on highway segments. Each record links one crew to one segment with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific work assignment.. Existence Justification: In NCDOT maintenance operations, crews are assigned to multiple highway segments over time for different maintenance activities (pothole repair, crack sealing, mowing, etc.), and each segment requires multiple crews throughout the year for various maintenance needs. The assignment itself is an operational business entity that maintenance supervisors actively create, schedule, track, and close out, with specific attributes like work type, assignment dates, duration, status, and costs that belong to the assignment relationship rather than to the crew or segment alone.'
}

  application_date date [note: 'The date when the material was applied to the pavement section during maintenance or construction activity']

  unit_cost decimal(15,2) [note: 'The cost per unit of material at the time of this specific application, which may differ from standard cost due to market conditions or procurement timing']
  weather_condition varchar [note: 'Weather conditions at the time of application, which can affect material performance and application quality']

  Note: 'This association product represents the Event of applying maintenance materials to pavement sections. It captures the operational record of material usage during maintenance, resurfacing, or rehabilitation activities. Each record links one material to one pavement section with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific application event.. Existence Justification: In NCDOT maintenance operations, materials (asphalt, sealant, concrete, etc.) are applied to multiple pavement sections across the highway network, and each pavement section receives multiple different materials over its lifecycle during routine maintenance, resurfacing, and rehabilitation activities. The business actively manages and tracks each material application as an operational event with specific quantities, dates, methods, costs, and work order references.'
}

Table maintenance.route {

  route_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the route based on functional hierarchy and jurisdiction (interstate, US highway, state highway, secondary road, local road, ramp, service road).']
  shoulder_width_feet decimal(5,2) [note: 'Average width of the paved or unpaved shoulder in feet. Important for maintenance operations and emergency vehicle access.']
  snow_priority_level varchar [note: 'Winter weather operations priority level for snow and ice removal. Priority 1 routes are cleared first during winter weather events.']
  speed_limit_mph varchar [note: 'Posted speed limit for the route in miles per hour. Used for traffic management and maintenance of traffic (MOT) planning.']

  strategic_highway_network_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the route is part of the Strategic Highway Network for national defense purposes. Affects maintenance standards and emergency response protocols.']

  urban_rural_designation varchar [note: 'Classification of the route location as urban, rural, or suburban. Impacts maintenance priorities, funding allocation, and operational strategies.']

  Note: 'Master reference table for route. Referenced by route_id.'
}

Table grant.program_vendor_eligibility {
  program_vendor_eligibility_id varchar [pk, note: 'Primary key for the program_vendor_eligibility association']
  grant_program_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the grant program for which vendor eligibility is being tracked']
  vendor_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the vendor whose eligibility is being tracked for this program']
  certification_expiry_date date [note: 'Date when the program-specific certification or eligibility expires and requires renewal for this vendor-program combination. Explicitly identified in detection reasoning.']
  created_date timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this program-vendor eligibility record was created in the system.']
  determined_by varchar [note: 'Name or identifier of the grant administrator or certifying official who determined eligibility for this vendor-program combination.']
  eligibility_determination_date date [note: 'Date when the eligibility determination was made by the grant program administrator for this vendor-program combination.']
  eligibility_notes varchar [note: 'Free-text notes documenting special conditions, waivers, or additional requirements for this vendor\'s eligibility in this specific program.']
  eligibility_status varchar [note: 'Current eligibility status of the vendor for this specific grant program. Tracks whether vendor meets program-specific requirements. Explicitly identified in detection reasoning.']
  last_updated_date timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this program-vendor eligibility record was last modified.']
  prequalification_date date [note: 'Date when the vendor was prequalified or approved for participation in this specific grant program. Explicitly identified in detection reasoning.']
  program_specific_certification varchar [note: 'Type or identifier of program-specific certification required and held by the vendor for this grant program (e.g., DBE certification for DBE programs, SBTDC certification). Explicitly identified in detection reasoning.']

  Note: 'This association product represents the prequalification and eligibility relationship between grant programs and vendors. It captures program-specific vendor certifications, eligibility status, and qualification dates that exist only in the context of a specific program-vendor combination. Each record links one grant program to one vendor with attributes tracking their eligibility and certification status for that specific program.. Existence Justification: In NCDOT grant administration, vendors must be prequalified for specific grant programs based on program-specific eligibility criteria and certifications. A single vendor can be eligible for multiple grant programs (e.g., a DBE-certified vendor may be prequalified for multiple federal highway programs), and each grant program maintains a roster of multiple eligible vendors. The eligibility relationship itself carries program-specific data including prequalification dates, certification types, eligibility status, and expiration dates that belong to neither the vendor master record nor the program master record alone.'
}

Table finance.project_funding {
  project_funding_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique identifier for each project funding allocation record. Primary key for the project_funding association.']
  fund_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the fund source providing financial resources for the project.']
  funding_allocation_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the funding allocation record that represents the source of funds being allocated to the project.']
  planned_project_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the planned infrastructure project that is receiving funding allocation.']
  project_boundary_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the geographic project boundary that defines the spatial scope of the project receiving funding.']
  allocated_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'The specific monetary amount from this funding allocation that is designated for this project or project phase.']
  allocation_date date [note: 'The date when this funding allocation was officially approved or assigned to the project.']
  allocation_effective_date date [note: 'The date from which this fund-to-project allocation becomes active and available for obligation or expenditure.']
  allocation_expiration_date date [note: 'The date after which this fund-to-project allocation is no longer valid or available for obligation, requiring reallocation or extension.']
  allocation_status varchar [note: 'The current lifecycle status of this specific funding allocation in the financial management process (e.g., planned, committed, obligated, expended).']
  created_date timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this project funding allocation record was initially created in the system.']
  expended_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Actual amount expended from this specific fund allocation to date, representing payments made against the allocated amount.']
  fiscal_year varchar [note: 'The fiscal year designation in which this funding allocation is budgeted or scheduled for the project.']
  funding_phase varchar [note: 'The specific project phase for which this funding is allocated (e.g., preliminary engineering, right-of-way acquisition, construction, environmental studies).']
  last_modified_by varchar [note: 'User or system identifier that last modified this project funding allocation record.']
  last_modified_date timestamp [note: 'Timestamp of the most recent modification to this project funding allocation record.']
  match_requirement_indicator boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this fund allocation requires matching funds from non-federal sources (state, local, or private).']
  match_requirement_percentage decimal(5,2) [note: 'The percentage of local or state matching funds required for this fund-to-project allocation, typically associated with federal funding programs.']
  obligation_date date [note: 'Date when the allocated funds were formally obligated through a contract, purchase order, or other binding commitment.']
  percentage_allocated decimal(5,2) [note: 'The percentage of the total funding allocation or total project cost that this specific fund-to-project allocation represents.']
  created_by varchar [note: 'User or system identifier that created this project funding allocation record.']

  Note: 'This association product represents the allocation of funding sources to transportation projects. It captures the financial commitment of specific funding allocations to project scopes, tracking the amount, timing, fiscal year, phase, status, and percentage of each fund-to-project relationship. Each record links one funding source to one project with attributes that exist only in the context of this funding relationship. In NCDOT operations, transportation projects routinely receive funding from multiple sources (federal STIP allocations, HSIP grants, state bonds, local matching funds, CMAQ programs, special revenue funds), and each funding source typically supports multiple projects across the state. The finance and planning teams actively manage these fund-to-project allocations through the STIP (State Transportation Improvement Program) process, tracking specific amounts, fiscal years, allocation dates, project phases (preliminary engineering, right-of-way, construction), statuses (planned, committed, obligated, expended), expenditure amounts, and percentage splits for compliance reporting to federal agencies and state oversight bodies.'
}

Table finance.audit_trail {

  status varchar [note: 'Current status of the audit trail record (active, archived, deleted).']
  transaction_id varchar [note: 'Unique identifier of the business transaction or event being audited. Links to the source transaction in the operational system.']
  transaction_type varchar [note: 'Type or category of the financial transaction being audited (e.g., journal entry, budget allocation, payment, transfer).']
  user_id varchar [note: 'System user identifier of the person who performed the audited action.']
  user_name varchar [note: 'Full name of the user who performed the audited action.']
  user_role varchar [note: 'Role or authorization level of the user at the time the action was performed (e.g., Accountant, Budget Manager, Approver, System Administrator).']

Table procurement.contract_segment {
  contract_segment_id varchar [pk, note: 'Primary key for the contract_segment association']
  contract_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the procurement contract governing this work']
  segment_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the highway segment where contract work is being performed']
  actual_completion_date date [note: 'Actual date when work was completed on this segment.']
  actual_start_date date [note: 'Actual date when work began on this segment.']
  completion_percentage decimal(5,2) [note: 'Percentage of work completed on this segment under this contract, used for progress tracking and payment processing. Range 0.00 to 100.00.']
  created_date timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this contract-segment association was created in the system.']
  last_updated_date timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this contract-segment record was last modified.']
  scheduled_completion_date date [note: 'Planned date for work to be completed on this specific segment.']
  scheduled_start_date date [note: 'Planned date for work to begin on this specific segment. May differ from contract start_date as segments are often worked sequentially.']
  segment_contract_value decimal(18,2) [note: 'Portion of the total contract value allocated to work on this specific segment. Used for financial tracking and payment allocation.']
  segment_end_milepost decimal(10,3) [note: 'Ending milepoint within the segment where contract work ends. May differ from segment end_milepoint if contract covers only a portion of the segment.']
  segment_start_milepost decimal(10,3) [note: 'Starting milepoint within the segment where contract work begins. May differ from segment begin_milepoint if contract covers only a portion of the segment.']
  status varchar [note: 'Current status of work on this specific segment under this contract. Tracks progress independently from overall contract status since segments may be completed at different times.']
  work_scope varchar [note: 'Detailed description of the specific work to be performed on this segment under this contract (e.g., \'Mill and overlay 2 inches asphalt\', \'Replace guardrail\', \'Drainage improvements\').']

  Note: 'This association product represents the work scope assignment between highway segments and procurement contracts. It captures the specific work to be performed on each segment under each contract, including milepost boundaries, work scope details, status tracking, and completion progress. Each record links one segment to one contract with attributes that exist only in the context of this contractual work assignment.. Existence Justification: In NCDOT highway operations, a single procurement contract routinely covers work on multiple highway segments (e.g., a resurfacing contract for a 50-mile corridor spanning 20 distinct segments), and conversely, a single segment frequently has multiple active contracts simultaneously for different types of work (resurfacing, guardrail replacement, drainage improvements, bridge work). Highway maintenance and construction managers actively track work scope, progress, completion percentage, and status for each segment-contract combination as a distinct operational unit.'
}

Table procurement.contract_assignment {
  contract_assignment_id varchar [pk, note: 'Primary key for the contract_assignment association']
  contract_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the contract being staffed']
  employee_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the employee assigned to the contract']
  assignment_date date [note: 'The date when the employee was formally assigned to this contract in this role. This attribute was explicitly identified in the detection phase relationship data.']
  assignment_status varchar [note: 'Current status of the assignment indicating whether the employee is actively working on the contract or if the assignment has ended.']
  end_date date [note: 'The date when the employee\'s assignment to this contract ended or is scheduled to end.']
  primary_contact_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this employee is the primary point of contact for this contract. Used for routing inquiries and establishing accountability. This attribute was explicitly identified in the detection phase relationship data.']
  responsibility_percentage decimal(5,2) [note: 'The percentage of the employee\'s time or workload allocated to this contract assignment. Used for workload balancing and capacity planning. This attribute was explicitly identified in the detection phase relationship data.']
  role varchar [note: 'The specific role or function the employee performs on this contract (e.g., contract manager, technical lead, financial officer, compliance officer). This attribute was explicitly identified in the detection phase relationship data.']
  start_date date [note: 'The date when the employee began active work on this contract assignment.']

  Note: 'This association product represents the assignment relationship between contracts and employees at NCDOT. It captures the formal assignment of NCDOT employees to contracts in specific roles (contract manager, technical lead, financial officer, compliance officer) with defined responsibilities and accountability. Each record links one contract to one employee with attributes that exist only in the context of this assignment relationship.. Existence Justification: In NCDOT operations, large contracts (construction, consulting, professional services) require multiple employees to be assigned in different roles such as contract manager, technical lead, financial officer, compliance officer, and inspectors. Each employee can be assigned to multiple contracts simultaneously with varying responsibility percentages. The business actively manages these assignments to track accountability, workload distribution, and ensure proper oversight of contract execution.'
}

Table hr.salary_grade {
  salary_grade_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique identifier for the salary grade record. Primary key for the salary grade reference data.']
  approval_date date [note: 'Date when this salary grade configuration was officially approved.']
  approval_status varchar [note: 'Approval workflow status for salary grade changes. Indicates whether the grade has been approved by appropriate authorities.']
  approved_by varchar [note: 'Name or identifier of the authority who approved this salary grade configuration (e.g., HR Director, State Legislature).']
  bargaining_unit_code varchar [note: 'Code identifying the collective bargaining unit or union representation applicable to this grade, if any.']
  bargaining_unit_name varchar [note: 'Name of the collective bargaining unit or union representation applicable to this grade.']
  budget_code varchar [note: 'Budget or appropriation code associated with positions in this salary grade for financial planning and tracking.']
  certification_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether professional certification or licensure is required for positions in this salary grade.']
  certification_type varchar [note: 'Type of professional certification or licensure required (e.g., \'PE - Professional Engineer\', \'CDL - Commercial Driver License\').']
  compa_ratio_target decimal(5,2) [note: 'Target comparative ratio (actual salary divided by midpoint salary) for positions in this grade. Typically 1.00 represents market rate.']
  cost_center varchar [note: 'Default cost center for positions assigned to this salary grade. Used for financial accounting and budget allocation.']
  currency_code varchar [note: 'ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for salary amounts. Typically USD for NCDOT.']
  eeo_category varchar [note: 'EEO job category classification for reporting purposes as defined by federal guidelines.']
  effective_date date [note: 'Date when this salary grade configuration becomes effective. Used for temporal tracking of compensation changes.']
  end_date date [note: 'Date when this salary grade configuration expires or is superseded. Null indicates currently active grade.']
  fiscal_year varchar [note: 'State fiscal year (SFY) for which this salary grade is applicable. Format: YYYY.']
  flsa_status varchar [note: 'Classification under the Fair Labor Standards Act indicating whether positions in this grade are exempt or non-exempt from overtime provisions.']
  grade_code varchar [note: 'Alphanumeric code representing the salary grade level. Used as a business key for classification and reference in HR systems.']
  grade_description varchar [note: 'Detailed description of the salary grade, including typical job responsibilities, qualifications, and organizational level.']
  grade_level varchar [note: 'Numeric level of the grade within the organizational hierarchy. Used for sorting and comparison purposes.']
  grade_name varchar [note: 'Descriptive name of the salary grade level (e.g., \'Grade 10\', \'Executive Level 3\', \'Technician II\').']
  grade_type varchar [note: 'Classification type of the salary grade indicating employment category (e.g., classified civil service, unclassified, temporary).']
  hazard_pay_eligible boolean [note: 'Indicates whether positions in this salary grade are eligible for hazard or danger pay due to working conditions.']
  job_family varchar [note: 'Broad occupational category or job family to which this grade applies (e.g., \'Engineering\', \'Administrative\', \'Transportation Operations\').']
  last_review_date date [note: 'Date when this salary grade was last reviewed for market competitiveness and internal equity.']
  market_reference_rate decimal(15,2) [note: 'External market benchmark salary rate for comparable positions. Used for competitive compensation analysis.']
  market_survey_date date [note: 'Date of the market compensation survey used for benchmarking this salary grade.']
  market_survey_source varchar [note: 'Source of market compensation data used for benchmarking this salary grade (e.g., \'Bureau of Labor Statistics\', \'State Salary Survey\').']
  maximum_hourly_rate decimal(10,2) [note: 'Maximum hourly wage rate for this grade in US dollars. Applicable for hourly or non-exempt positions.']
  maximum_salary decimal(15,2) [note: 'Maximum annual salary amount for this grade in US dollars. Represents the ceiling of the compensation range.']
  midpoint_salary decimal(15,2) [note: 'Midpoint or target annual salary amount for this grade in US dollars. Represents the market-competitive rate for fully competent performance.']
  minimum_education_level varchar [note: 'Minimum educational qualification typically required for positions in this salary grade.']
  minimum_experience_years varchar [note: 'Minimum number of years of relevant work experience typically required for positions in this salary grade.']
  minimum_hourly_rate decimal(10,2) [note: 'Minimum hourly wage rate for this grade in US dollars. Applicable for hourly or non-exempt positions.']
  minimum_salary decimal(15,2) [note: 'Minimum annual salary amount for this grade in US dollars. Represents the floor of the compensation range.']

  notes varchar [note: 'Additional notes, comments, or special instructions related to this salary grade configuration.']

  overtime_eligible boolean [note: 'Indicates whether positions in this salary grade are eligible for overtime compensation under FLSA and state regulations.']
  pay_frequency varchar [note: 'Standard pay frequency for positions in this grade (e.g., monthly, biweekly).']

  pay_plan_name varchar [note: 'Name of the pay plan or compensation structure (e.g., \'State Salary Plan\', \'Executive Compensation Plan\').']
  position_count varchar [note: 'Number of authorized positions allocated to this salary grade. Used for workforce planning and budget management.']
  range_spread_percentage decimal(5,2) [note: 'Percentage spread between minimum and maximum salary for this grade. Calculated as (max - min) / min * 100.']
  shift_differential_eligible boolean [note: 'Indicates whether positions in this salary grade are eligible for shift differential pay for non-standard work hours.']
  source_system varchar [note: 'System of record from which this salary grade data originated (e.g., SAP HR, Beacon, Manual entry).']
  source_system_id varchar [note: 'Unique identifier for this salary grade record in the source system of record.']
  span_of_control_max varchar [note: 'Maximum number of direct reports typically expected for supervisory positions in this grade.']
  span_of_control_min varchar [note: 'Minimum number of direct reports typically expected for supervisory positions in this grade.']
  status varchar [note: 'Current status of the salary grade record indicating whether it is active, inactive, pending approval, or superseded by a newer version.']
  step_count varchar [note: 'Number of incremental pay steps within this salary grade. Used for progression-based compensation structures.']
  step_increment_amount decimal(10,2) [note: 'Dollar amount of each incremental step increase within the salary grade.']
  step_increment_percentage decimal(5,2) [note: 'Percentage increase for each incremental step within the salary grade.']
  supervisory_level varchar [note: 'Level of supervisory responsibility typically associated with positions in this salary grade.']
  telework_eligible boolean [note: 'Indicates whether positions in this salary grade are eligible for telework or remote work arrangements.']

  Note: 'Reference data defining salary grades, pay ranges, and associated position levels used for compensation planning.'
}

Table hr.time_entry {

  employee_id varchar [note: 'Unique identifier for the employee submitting the time entry. Links to employee master record in Beacon or SAP HR.']

  trip_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to transit.trip. Business justification: Transit operators log time entries against specific trips they operated. Payroll uses this to calculate hours worked, overtime, and verify actual service delivery against scheduled trips.']
  activity_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the work activity performed (e.g., design, construction inspection, maintenance, administrative). Used for labor distribution analysis.']

  leave_type varchar [note: 'Category of leave taken if leave hours are recorded. Determines leave balance deduction and pay treatment.']
  overtime_hours decimal(5,2) [note: 'Number of overtime hours worked beyond regular hours threshold. Subject to overtime pay rates per FLSA and state regulations.']
  pay_code varchar [note: 'Code representing the type of pay associated with the time entry (e.g., regular pay, overtime, shift differential, hazard pay).']
  payroll_period varchar [note: 'Identifier for the payroll period (e.g., bi-weekly period ending date) to which this time entry belongs.']
  regular_hours decimal(5,2) [note: 'Number of regular hours worked, typically up to 8 hours per day or 40 hours per week for non-exempt employees.']
  rejection_reason varchar [note: 'Explanation provided by the approver if the time entry was rejected. Guides employee correction.']
  shift_code varchar [note: 'Identifier for the work shift (e.g., day, evening, night) if applicable. May affect shift differential pay.']

  status varchar [note: 'Current approval and processing status of the time entry record. Controls payroll processing and editing permissions.']
  submitted_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time when the employee submitted the time entry for supervisor approval.']
  wbs_element varchar [note: 'Hierarchical project structure element for detailed project cost tracking and reporting. Used in SAP PS for project management.']
  work_date date [note: 'The calendar date on which the work was performed. Used for payroll period assignment and labor cost allocation.']
  work_location varchar [note: 'Physical location or site where the work was performed. May be office, field site, or remote.']
  work_order_number varchar [note: 'Maintenance or service work order number to which the time is charged, if applicable.']

  Note: 'Transactional record of daily employee work hours, project codes, and overtime, used for payroll and labor reporting.'
}

Table hr.project_assignment {
  project_assignment_id varchar [pk, note: 'Primary key for the project_assignment association']
  employee_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the NCDOT employee assigned to the project']
  project_boundary_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the project boundary for which the employee is assigned']
  allocation_percentage decimal(5,2) [note: 'Percentage of the employee\'s time allocated to this project (0.00 to 100.00)']
  assignment_end_date date [note: 'The date when the employee completed or was removed from this project assignment. Explicitly identified in detection phase as relationship data.']
  assignment_start_date date [note: 'The date when the employee began working on this project. Explicitly identified in detection phase as relationship data.']
  assignment_status varchar [note: 'Current status of the employee assignment to the project']
  created_date timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when the assignment record was created in the system']
  modified_by varchar [note: 'User ID of the person who last modified the assignment record']
  modified_date timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when the assignment record was last modified']
  primary_responsibility_area varchar [note: 'The primary area of responsibility or work scope assigned to the employee for this project (e.g., Design, Construction Oversight, Environmental Compliance, ROW Acquisition). Explicitly identified in detection phase as relationship data.']
  role_on_project varchar [note: 'The specific role or function the employee performs on this project (e.g., Project Manager, Lead Engineer, Inspector). Explicitly identified in detection phase as relationship data.']
  created_by varchar [note: 'User ID of the person who created the assignment record']

  Note: 'This association product represents the Assignment between employee and project_boundary. It captures the formal assignment of NCDOT employees to transportation projects with specific roles, responsibilities, and time periods. Each record links one employee to one project boundary with attributes that exist only in the context of this assignment relationship.. Existence Justification: In NCDOT operations, transportation projects require multiple employees with different roles (project managers, engineers, inspectors, environmental specialists, ROW agents) working simultaneously or sequentially on the same project. Conversely, employees work on multiple projects across different districts and time periods throughout their careers. The business actively manages these assignments with specific roles, responsibility areas, and time periods for resource allocation, project staffing, and workforce utilization tracking.'
}

  extent_xmax decimal(18,6) [note: 'The maximum X coordinate (easternmost longitude) of the bounding box encompassing all features in this layer.']

  extent_ymin decimal(18,6) [note: 'The minimum Y coordinate (southernmost latitude) of the bounding box encompassing all features in this layer.']

  geometry_type varchar [note: 'The geometric representation type for feature layers, defining how spatial features are stored and displayed (e.g., highway centerlines as polylines, bridge locations as points).']

  has_m_values boolean [note: 'Indicates whether feature geometries in this layer include M (measure) values for linear referencing along routes.']
  has_z_values boolean [note: 'Indicates whether feature geometries in this layer include Z coordinate values for elevation or height.']

  is_versioned boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the source dataset for this layer is registered as versioned in the geodatabase, enabling version-based editing.']

  label_field varchar [note: 'The attribute field name used to generate labels for features in this layer when labeling is enabled.']

  max_image_width varchar [note: 'The maximum width in pixels for map images exported from this layer service.']

  max_scale decimal(18,2) [note: 'The maximum map scale at which this layer is visible. Layers are hidden when zoomed in beyond this scale to prevent inappropriate detail levels.']

  min_lod varchar [note: 'The minimum zoom level (level of detail) at which tiles are generated and displayed for this cached layer.']

  object_id_field varchar [note: 'The name of the field containing unique object identifiers for features in this layer (typically OBJECTID or FID).']
  opacity decimal(5,2) [note: 'The transparency level of the layer expressed as a percentage (0-100), where 100 is fully opaque and 0 is fully transparent.']

  positional_accuracy_meters decimal(10,2) [note: 'The estimated horizontal positional accuracy of features in this layer expressed in meters, indicating spatial precision.']
  publication_date date [note: 'The date when this map layer was first published to ArcGIS Enterprise and made available to users.']
  quality_score decimal(5,2) [note: 'A numeric score (0-100) representing the overall data quality of this layer based on completeness, accuracy, and currency assessments.']
  refresh_interval varchar [note: 'The number of seconds between automatic refreshes of this layer in web maps and applications, used for real-time or frequently updated data.']
  renderer_definition varchar [note: 'The JSON or XML definition of the rendering properties including symbols, colors, sizes, and classification rules applied to this layer.']
  renderer_type varchar [note: 'The symbolization method used to render features in this layer, determining how data values are visually represented on the map.']

  service_url varchar [note: 'The REST endpoint URL where this map layer service is published and accessible to consuming applications and users.']
  shape_field varchar [note: 'The name of the geometry field containing the spatial coordinates and shape information for features in this layer.']
  sharing_level varchar [note: 'The ArcGIS Enterprise sharing configuration controlling which users and groups can access this layer.']
  source_database varchar [note: 'The database or geodatabase containing the source dataset for this map layer (e.g., SDE connection, file geodatabase path).']
  source_dataset_name varchar [note: 'The name of the underlying source dataset or feature class from which this map layer is derived. Links the published layer to its authoritative data source.']
  status varchar [note: 'The current operational status of the map layer indicating whether it is actively published and available for use.']
  supports_attachments boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this layer supports file attachments (photos, documents) associated with individual features.']
  supports_editing boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this layer allows users to create, update, or delete features through web editing interfaces.']
  supports_query boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this layer supports attribute and spatial queries through the REST API.']
  supports_time boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this layer is time-enabled, allowing temporal queries and animation of features over time.']
  sync_enabled boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this layer supports offline synchronization for mobile and disconnected editing workflows.']
  tags varchar [note: 'Comma-separated keywords and tags used for searching and discovering this layer in ArcGIS Enterprise catalogs and portals.']
  thumbnail_url varchar [note: 'The URL to a thumbnail image preview of this map layer used in catalogs and search results.']
  tile_cache_enabled boolean [note: 'Indicates whether pre-generated map tiles are cached for this layer to improve performance and reduce server load.']
  tile_scheme varchar [note: 'The tiling scheme used for cached layers, defining the spatial reference, tile size, and level of detail structure.']
  time_field varchar [note: 'The attribute field name containing timestamp values used for temporal queries and visualization when time support is enabled.']
  time_interval varchar [note: 'The time interval unit and value for temporal aggregation or animation (e.g., 1 day, 1 hour).']
