  visibility varchar [note: 'The access visibility level determining who can discover and view this map layer within and outside NCDOT.']

  Note: 'Master record for each map layer published in ArcGIS Enterprise, including layer name, source data set, scale range, and rendering properties.'
}

Table gis.feature {
  feature_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique identifier for the geographic feature within the GIS system.']
  map_layer_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to gis.map_layer. Business justification: Features are published and organized through map layers in ArcGIS Enterprise. Each feature belongs to a specific map layer for visualization, querying, and analysis. This is a fundamental GIS relation']
  spatial_reference_id varchar [note: 'The spatial reference system identifier (SRID) defining the coordinate system and projection used for the feature geometry.']
  stip_project_id varchar [note: 'The State Transportation Improvement Program (STIP) project identifier associated with the feature construction or improvement.']
  tip_project_id varchar [note: 'The Transportation Improvement Program (TIP) project identifier for metropolitan planning organization projects.']
  aadt varchar [note: 'The Annual Average Daily Traffic (AADT) volume for the feature, representing the total volume of vehicle traffic on a roadway for a year divided by 365 days.']
  aadt_year varchar [note: 'The year in which the AADT measurement was recorded.']
  acquisition_cost_usd decimal(18,2) [note: 'The original acquisition or construction cost of the feature in US dollars.']
  ada_compliant_indicator boolean [note: 'Indicator whether the feature meets Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) accessibility requirements.']
  area_square_meters decimal(18,4) [note: 'The calculated area of the feature in square meters, applicable to polygon features.']
  asset_condition_rating varchar [note: 'The overall condition rating of the asset (excellent, good, fair, poor, critical).']
  attachment_count varchar [note: 'The number of file attachments (photos, documents, drawings) associated with the feature.']
  begin_milepost decimal(10,3) [note: 'The beginning milepost or linear reference measure for the feature along the route.']
  class_name varchar [note: 'The name of the feature class or layer to which this feature belongs within the GIS database.']
  code varchar [note: 'Standardized code classifying the feature according to NCDOT or AASHTO feature classification schemes.']
  construction_year varchar [note: 'The year the feature was originally constructed or installed.']
  coordinate_system_name varchar [note: 'The name of the coordinate system or projection used for the feature (e.g., NAD83 State Plane North Carolina, WGS84).']
  county_code varchar [note: 'The North Carolina county code where the feature is located.']
  county_name varchar [note: 'The name of the North Carolina county where the feature is located.']
  created_date timestamp [note: 'The timestamp when the feature record was originally created in the GIS system.']
  data_accuracy_meters decimal(8,3) [note: 'The horizontal positional accuracy of the feature geometry in meters.']
  data_collection_date date [note: 'The date the feature data was originally collected or surveyed.']
  data_quality_score decimal(5,2) [note: 'A composite data quality score (0-100) assessing completeness, accuracy, consistency, and timeliness of the feature data.']
  data_source varchar [note: 'The source system or method from which the feature data was collected (e.g., GPS survey, aerial imagery, CAD conversion, field collection).']
  dataset_name varchar [note: 'The name of the feature dataset grouping related feature classes within the geodatabase.']
  description varchar [note: 'A detailed textual description of the feature providing additional context and information.']
  district_number varchar [note: 'The NCDOT district number within the division responsible for the feature.']
  division_number varchar [note: 'The NCDOT division number (1-14) responsible for the geographic area containing the feature.']
  edit_date timestamp [note: 'The timestamp when the feature was last edited or modified.']
  editor_name varchar [note: 'The name or identifier of the user who last edited the feature.']
  effective_end_date date [note: 'The date when the feature ceased or will cease to be effective or operational.']
  effective_start_date date [note: 'The date when the feature became or will become effective or operational.']
  end_milepost decimal(10,3) [note: 'The ending milepost or linear reference measure for the feature along the route.']
  environmental_clearance_status varchar [note: 'The status of environmental clearance for the feature (not required, pending, approved, CE, EA, EIS, FONSI).']
  environmental_document_type varchar [note: 'The type of environmental documentation completed for the feature (CE - Categorical Exclusion, EA - Environmental Assessment, EIS - Environmental Impact Statement, FONSI - Finding of No Significant Impact).']
  estimated_useful_life_years varchar [note: 'The estimated useful life of the feature in years from the time of construction or last major rehabilitation.']
  federal_aid_eligible_indicator boolean [note: 'Indicator whether the feature is eligible for federal transportation funding.']
  functional_class_code varchar [note: 'The functional classification code for transportation features according to FHWA standards (e.g., interstate, principal arterial, collector).']
  funding_source varchar [note: 'The primary funding source for the feature construction or maintenance (state, federal, local, private, mixed).']
  geometry_wkb varchar [note: 'The spatial geometry of the feature represented in Well-Known Binary (WKB) format for efficient storage and processing.']
  geometry_wkt varchar [note: 'The spatial geometry of the feature represented in Well-Known Text (WKT) format for interoperability.']
  global_id varchar [note: 'Globally unique identifier (GUID) for the feature enabling synchronization and replication across distributed GIS environments.']
  historic_designation varchar [note: 'The historic preservation designation status of the feature (none, eligible, listed, contributing, non-contributing).']
  hyperlink_url varchar [note: 'A hyperlink URL to external resources or documentation related to the feature.']
  inspection_frequency_months varchar [note: 'The required frequency of inspections in months for the feature.']
  iri_value decimal(6,2) [note: 'The International Roughness Index (IRI) value measuring pavement roughness in inches per mile or meters per kilometer.']
  lane_width_feet decimal(5,2) [note: 'The width of travel lanes in feet for roadway features.']
  last_maintenance_date date [note: 'The date the feature last received maintenance activities.']
  last_rehabilitation_year varchar [note: 'The year the feature was last rehabilitated or underwent major reconstruction.']
  length_meters decimal(18,4) [note: 'The calculated length of the feature in meters, applicable to line and polygon features.']
  maintenance_unit_code varchar [note: 'The code identifying the NCDOT maintenance unit responsible for the feature.']
  median_type varchar [note: 'The type of median separating opposing traffic lanes (none, painted, raised, barrier, depressed).']
  median_width_feet decimal(5,2) [note: 'The width of the median in feet, if applicable.']
  metadata_standard varchar [note: 'The metadata standard used to document the feature (e.g., FGDC CSDGM, ISO 19115).']
  municipality_code varchar [note: 'The code identifying the municipality or incorporated area where the feature is located.']
  municipality_name varchar [note: 'The name of the municipality or incorporated area where the feature is located.']
  name varchar [note: 'The descriptive name or label assigned to the geographic feature for identification and display purposes.']
  next_inspection_date date [note: 'The scheduled date for the next inspection of the feature.']
  nhs_indicator boolean [note: 'Indicator whether the feature is part of the National Highway System (NHS).']
  number_of_lanes varchar [note: 'The total number of travel lanes for roadway features.']
  object_id varchar [note: 'Internal object identifier assigned by the geodatabase for feature management and indexing.']
  ownership_type varchar [note: 'The type of ownership or jurisdiction for the feature (state, federal, county, municipal, private).']
  parent_feature_id varchar [note: 'The identifier of the parent feature in hierarchical feature relationships (e.g., a segment belonging to a route).']
  pavement_condition_index decimal(5,2) [note: 'The Pavement Condition Index (PCI) score representing the overall condition of the pavement surface (0-100 scale).']
  perimeter_meters decimal(18,4) [note: 'The calculated perimeter of the feature in meters, applicable to polygon features.']
  public_access_indicator boolean [note: 'Indicator whether the feature data is available for public access and distribution.']
  publication_status varchar [note: 'The publication status of the feature in the GIS system (draft, published, archived, deprecated).']
  replacement_cost_usd decimal(18,2) [note: 'The estimated cost to replace the feature in current US dollars.']
  right_of_way_width_feet decimal(8,2) [note: 'The width of the right-of-way (ROW) corridor in feet for transportation features.']
  route_id varchar [note: 'The route identifier for transportation features, linking to the NCDOT route system (e.g., I-40, US-1, NC-55).']
  route_name varchar [note: 'The common or official name of the route associated with the feature (e.g., Interstate 40, Capital Boulevard).']
  security_classification varchar [note: 'The security classification level of the feature data (public, internal, confidential, restricted).']
  shoulder_width_feet decimal(5,2) [note: 'The width of roadway shoulders in feet.']
  speed_limit_mph varchar [note: 'The posted speed limit in miles per hour for roadway features.']
  status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the feature indicating whether it is active, proposed, under construction, or retired.']
  subtype varchar [note: 'Subtype classification providing additional granularity within the feature class (e.g., interstate highway, state route, local road).']
  surface_type varchar [note: 'The type of surface material for transportation features (asphalt, concrete, gravel, unpaved).']
  truck_percentage decimal(5,2) [note: 'The percentage of total traffic volume consisting of trucks and heavy vehicles.']
  type varchar [note: 'The geometric type of the feature representing its spatial structure (point, line, polygon, or multi-part variants).']
  version_number varchar [note: 'The version number of the feature record for tracking changes and history.']
  vertical_accuracy_meters decimal(8,3) [note: 'The vertical positional accuracy of the feature elevation data in meters.']
  x_coordinate decimal(18,8) [note: 'The X coordinate (longitude) of the feature centroid or representative point in the defined spatial reference system.']
  y_coordinate decimal(18,8) [note: 'The Y coordinate (latitude) of the feature centroid or representative point in the defined spatial reference system.']
  z_coordinate decimal(18,8) [note: 'The Z coordinate (elevation) of the feature in the defined spatial reference system, if applicable.']
  created_by varchar [note: 'The name or identifier of the user who originally created the feature record.']

  Note: 'Master representation of a geographic feature (point, line, polygon) with geometry, attributes, and lifecycle status.'
}

Table gis.spatial_reference {
  spatial_reference_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique identifier for the spatial reference system record. Primary key for the spatial reference table.']
  accuracy_meters decimal(10,3) [note: 'Estimated positional accuracy or precision of coordinates expressed in this reference system, measured in meters.']
  angular_unit_conversion_factor decimal(20,10) [note: 'Conversion factor to transform the angular unit to radians. For example, degree = 0.0174532925199433 radians.']
  angular_unit_name varchar [note: 'Name of the angular unit of measurement used for coordinate values in geographic coordinate systems.']
  arcgis_compatible_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this spatial reference system is natively supported and compatible with ESRI ArcGIS Enterprise platform used by NCDOT.']
  area_of_use_description varchar [note: 'Textual description of the geographic area or region where this coordinate reference system is intended to be used and provides accurate results.']
  area_of_use_east_bound decimal(10,6) [note: 'Eastern longitude boundary of the area where this coordinate reference system is valid, measured in decimal degrees.']
  area_of_use_north_bound decimal(10,6) [note: 'Northern latitude boundary of the area where this coordinate reference system is valid, measured in decimal degrees.']
  area_of_use_south_bound decimal(10,6) [note: 'Southern latitude boundary of the area where this coordinate reference system is valid, measured in decimal degrees.']
  area_of_use_west_bound decimal(10,6) [note: 'Western longitude boundary of the area where this coordinate reference system is valid, measured in decimal degrees.']
  authority varchar [note: 'Organization or body that defines and maintains the spatial reference system standard.']
  authority_code varchar [note: 'Code assigned by the authority organization to uniquely identify this spatial reference system within their namespace.']
  axis_1_name varchar [note: 'Name of the first coordinate axis, such as Easting, Longitude, or X.']
  axis_1_orientation varchar [note: 'Direction or orientation of the first coordinate axis in the coordinate system.']
  axis_2_name varchar [note: 'Name of the second coordinate axis, such as Northing, Latitude, or Y.']
  axis_2_orientation varchar [note: 'Direction or orientation of the second coordinate axis in the coordinate system.']
  axis_3_name varchar [note: 'Name of the third coordinate axis for 3D systems, typically Elevation, Height, or Z.']
  axis_3_orientation varchar [note: 'Direction or orientation of the third coordinate axis in 3D coordinate systems.']
  axis_count varchar [note: 'Number of coordinate axes in the coordinate system. Typically 2 for 2D systems, 3 for 3D systems including elevation.']
  central_meridian decimal(10,6) [note: 'Longitude of the central meridian for the map projection, measured in angular units. Defines the line of zero distortion for many projections.']
  coordinate_system_type varchar [note: 'Mathematical type of the coordinate system defining how coordinates are structured and interpreted.']
  datum_name varchar [note: 'Name of the geodetic datum defining the reference ellipsoid and its relationship to the Earth. Examples include NAD83, WGS84, NAD27.']
  deprecated_date date [note: 'Date on which this spatial reference system was officially deprecated or superseded, formatted as yyyy-MM-dd.']
  deprecated_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this spatial reference system has been deprecated or superseded by a newer definition. True if deprecated, false if current.']
  effective_date date [note: 'Date on which this spatial reference system definition became officially effective and available for use, formatted as yyyy-MM-dd.']
  ellipsoid_name varchar [note: 'Name of the mathematical ellipsoid model used to approximate the shape of the Earth for this coordinate system.']
  epsg_code varchar [note: 'Standardized numeric code identifying the coordinate reference system as defined by the EPSG Geodetic Parameter Dataset. Primary identifier used across GIS applications.']
  esri_wkt varchar [note: 'ESRI-specific Well-Known Text representation of the coordinate reference system, which may differ from OGC WKT in syntax and parameter names.']
  false_easting decimal(20,6) [note: 'Value added to all x-coordinates in a projected coordinate system to ensure all coordinates are positive. Measured in the linear unit of the projection.']
  false_northing decimal(20,6) [note: 'Value added to all y-coordinates in a projected coordinate system to ensure all coordinates are positive. Measured in the linear unit of the projection.']
  information_source varchar [note: 'Citation or reference to the authoritative source document or organization that defines this spatial reference system.']
  inverse_flattening decimal(20,10) [note: 'Inverse of the flattening parameter of the reference ellipsoid, defining the ellipsoid\'s shape. Calculated as a/(a-b) where a is semi-major axis and b is semi-minor axis.']
  iso_code varchar [note: 'ISO 19111 standard code or identifier for this coordinate reference system.']
  latitude_of_origin decimal(10,6) [note: 'Latitude at which the projection plane intersects the ellipsoid, measured in angular units. Origin point for coordinate calculations.']
  linear_unit_conversion_factor decimal(20,10) [note: 'Conversion factor to transform the linear unit to meters. For example, US survey foot = 0.3048006096012192 meters.']
  linear_unit_name varchar [note: 'Name of the linear unit of measurement used for coordinate values in projected coordinate systems.']
  name varchar [note: 'Official name of the spatial reference system or coordinate reference system.']
  ncdot_primary_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this is a primary or standard coordinate system for NCDOT statewide operations. True if primary standard, false otherwise.']
  ncdot_usage_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this spatial reference system is actively used in NCDOT GIS operations and data products. True if used by NCDOT, false otherwise.']
  ogc_urn varchar [note: 'OGC URN identifier for this coordinate reference system, used in web services and standards-compliant applications.']
  prime_meridian_name varchar [note: 'Name of the prime meridian (zero longitude reference) used by this coordinate system. Most commonly Greenwich.']
  prime_meridian_offset decimal(10,6) [note: 'Angular offset in degrees of the prime meridian from the Greenwich meridian. Zero for Greenwich-based systems.']
  proj4_text varchar [note: 'PROJ.4 format string defining the coordinate reference system parameters for use with PROJ library and compatible software.']
  projection_name varchar [note: 'Name of the mathematical projection method used to transform coordinates from the ellipsoid to a planar surface. Applicable only to projected coordinate systems.']
  remarks varchar [note: 'Additional notes, comments, or guidance regarding the use, limitations, or special considerations for this spatial reference system.']
  revision_date date [note: 'Date of the most recent revision or update to the spatial reference system definition, formatted as yyyy-MM-dd.']
  scale_factor decimal(10,8) [note: 'Scale reduction factor applied at the central meridian or origin to minimize overall distortion across the projection zone.']
  scope varchar [note: 'Description of the intended application domain and use cases for this coordinate reference system, such as large-scale mapping, engineering surveys, or navigation.']
  semi_major_axis decimal(20,10) [note: 'Length of the semi-major axis (equatorial radius) of the reference ellipsoid, measured in meters.']
  srid varchar [note: 'Spatial Reference System Identifier used in spatial databases to uniquely identify coordinate systems. Often synonymous with EPSG code.']
  standard_parallel_1 decimal(10,6) [note: 'Latitude of the first standard parallel for conic projections, measured in angular units. Defines a line of true scale.']
  standard_parallel_2 decimal(10,6) [note: 'Latitude of the second standard parallel for conic projections, measured in angular units. Defines a second line of true scale.']
  state_plane_zone varchar [note: 'Identifier for the State Plane Coordinate System zone applicable to North Carolina, if this spatial reference represents a state plane system.']
  status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the spatial reference system indicating whether it is actively used, deprecated, or superseded.']
  superseded_by_epsg_code varchar [note: 'EPSG code of the spatial reference system that supersedes or replaces this deprecated system.']
  transformation_accuracy_meters decimal(10,3) [note: 'Expected accuracy of coordinate transformations from this reference system to other systems, measured in meters.']
  transformation_method varchar [note: 'Name of the mathematical method or algorithm used to transform coordinates between this system and other reference systems.']
  type varchar [note: 'Classification of the coordinate reference system indicating its fundamental structure and application domain.']
  utm_zone varchar [note: 'UTM zone identifier if this spatial reference represents a UTM coordinate system. Format includes zone number and hemisphere (e.g., 17N, 18S).']
  vertical_datum_name varchar [note: 'Name of the vertical datum or reference surface used for elevation measurements, such as NAVD88 or NGVD29.']
  wkt varchar [note: 'Complete Well-Known Text string representation of the coordinate reference system including all parameters and definitions.']

  Note: 'Reference table of spatial reference identifiers (EPSG codes) used to define coordinate systems for GIS data.'
}

Table gis.geocode_request {
  geocode_request_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique identifier for each geocoding request submitted to the GIS system.']
  driver_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to dmv.driver. Business justification: Geocoding driver addresses for spatial analysis, route planning for mobile DMV services, and verifying address accuracy during license applications and renewals.']
  employee_id varchar [note: 'The system user identifier or NCID of the person or application that submitted the geocoding request.']
  parcel_id varchar [note: 'The county tax parcel identifier if the geocoded location can be associated with a specific property parcel.']
  requested_by_employee_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to hr.employee. Business justification: GIS geocoding requests are submitted by NCDOT employees for incident locations, asset mapping, or planning analysis. System tracks which employee initiated each geocode request for audit and workload ']
  spatial_reference_id varchar [note: 'The EPSG numeric code identifying the coordinate reference system used.']
  vehicle_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to dmv.vehicle. Business justification: Geocoding vehicle registration addresses for spatial distribution analysis, enforcement zone mapping, and validating registration address accuracy for tax jurisdiction determination.']
  accuracy_radius_ft decimal(8,2) [note: 'The estimated accuracy radius in feet representing the confidence area around the geocoded coordinates.']
  address_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the input address type (e.g., street address, intersection, postal code, landmark).']
  batch_id varchar [note: 'Identifier linking this request to a batch geocoding job, if applicable.']
  cache_hit boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the geocoding result was retrieved from cache rather than processed in real-time.']
  census_block_group varchar [note: 'The US Census Bureau block group identifier for the geocoded location.']
  census_tract varchar [note: 'The US Census Bureau tract identifier for the geocoded location.']

  match_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the geocoding match quality indicating how the coordinates were determined.']

  matched_zip_code varchar [note: 'The standardized ZIP code from the matched address.']
  milepost decimal(8,3) [note: 'The milepost location along the route if the geocoded address is on a state-maintained roadway.']
  mpo_name varchar [note: 'The name of the MPO if the location falls within a metropolitan planning area.']
  municipality varchar [note: 'The incorporated city or town name if the location falls within municipal boundaries.']
  notes varchar [note: 'Additional notes or comments about the geocoding request or result.']
  offset_distance_ft decimal(8,2) [note: 'The perpendicular distance in feet from the road centerline to the geocoded point.']
  processing_time_ms varchar [note: 'The elapsed time in milliseconds to complete the geocoding request.']
  quality_flag varchar [note: 'Overall quality assessment flag for the geocoding result based on match score and validation rules.']
  reference_data_source varchar [note: 'The authoritative address or street dataset used as reference for geocoding (e.g., NCDOT Road Centerline, USPS Address Database).']
  reference_data_version varchar [note: 'The version or effective date of the reference data used for geocoding.']
  request_purpose varchar [note: 'The business purpose or use case for the geocoding request (e.g., project planning, asset location, incident mapping).']
  request_status varchar [note: 'Current processing status of the geocoding request.']
  request_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time when the geocoding request was submitted to the system.']
  requestor_application varchar [note: 'The name of the application or system that initiated the geocoding request.']
  requestor_ip_address varchar [note: 'The IP address of the client or system that submitted the geocoding request.']
  result_latitude decimal(10,7) [note: 'The latitude coordinate (in decimal degrees) returned by the geocoding service for the matched location.']
  result_longitude decimal(10,7) [note: 'The longitude coordinate (in decimal degrees) returned by the geocoding service for the matched location.']
  retry_count varchar [note: 'The number of retry attempts made for this geocoding request before success or final failure.']
  route_id varchar [note: 'The NCDOT route identifier if the matched location is associated with a specific highway or road route.']
  rpo_name varchar [note: 'The name of the RPO if the location falls within a rural planning area.']

  state_senate_district varchar [note: 'The North Carolina State Senate district in which the geocoded location resides.']
  township varchar [note: 'The township name if applicable to the geocoded location.']

  Note: 'Transactional record of each address-to-coordinate lookup request, including input address, request timestamp, status, and resulting latitude/longitude.'
}

Project managers track expenditures against cost centers for budget control.']

  notes varchar [note: 'Additional comments, special instructions, or operational notes about the tile cache configuration and usage.']
  owner_contact_email varchar [note: 'Email address of the primary contact person for questions and issues related to the tile cache.']

  refresh_schedule_cron varchar [note: 'Cron expression defining the specific timing for automated tile cache refresh operations.']
  refresh_schedule_type varchar [note: 'Frequency pattern for updating the tile cache with new source data to maintain currency and accuracy.']

  retention_period_days varchar [note: 'Number of days that tile cache versions and backups are retained before archival or deletion.']

  storage_location_path varchar [note: 'File system path, network share, or cloud storage location where the tile cache files are physically stored.']
  storage_type varchar [note: 'Method used to store tile cache files, affecting performance, scalability, and management characteristics.']
  tags varchar [note: 'Comma-separated keywords or labels for categorizing and searching the tile cache in GIS portals.']
  tile_count varchar [note: 'Total number of individual tiles stored in the cache across all zoom levels and spatial extents.']
  tile_format varchar [note: 'Image or data format used for storing individual tiles in the cache, affecting file size, quality, and compatibility.']
  tile_height_pixels varchar [note: 'Height of each tile image in pixels, typically 256 or 512 pixels for standard web mapping applications.']
  tile_matrix_set varchar [note: 'Tiling scheme identifier defining the spatial reference system, origin, tile dimensions, and scale levels used for the cache.']
  tile_origin_x decimal(20,6) [note: 'X-coordinate of the tile matrix origin point in the spatial reference system, defining the starting point for tile indexing.']
  tile_origin_y decimal(20,6) [note: 'Y-coordinate of the tile matrix origin point in the spatial reference system, defining the starting point for tile indexing.']
  tile_width_pixels varchar [note: 'Width of each tile image in pixels, typically 256 or 512 pixels for standard web mapping applications.']
  transparency_enabled boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the tile cache supports transparent backgrounds, allowing overlay on other map layers.']
  usage_category varchar [note: 'Primary use case category for the tile cache within NCDOT operations and services.']
  version_number varchar [note: 'Version identifier for the tile cache configuration and content, used for change tracking.']
  wmts_endpoint_url varchar [note: 'OGC WMTS standard endpoint for accessing the tile cache through standard web mapping protocols.']

  Note: 'Reference data describing cached map tiles, including tile matrix set, zoom levels, storage location, and refresh schedule.'
}
